sources/context-compression-techniques.summary: Comprehensive survey of compression techniques: hard prompts (LLMLingua, 20x), soft prompts (480x), hierarchical summarization, adaptive compression (83% reduction at 100 messages), and structured pruning (Provence, 95%).

sources/context-engineering-2026.title: Source: Context Engineering — The Emerging Discipline (2025-2026)
sources/context-engineering-2026.summary: Context engineering as the successor to prompt engineering: managing everything the model sees during inference — structured context objects, ACE framework, three dimensions (collection, management, usage).

sources/copyright-ai-training-data-2025.title: Source: AI Trends 2026 — Copyright Litigation Shifts
sources/copyright-ai-training-data-2025.summary: 2025 court rulings found AI training 'highly transformative' (Bartz v Anthropic, Kadrey v Meta), but Thomson Reuters v ROSS went the other way; 2026 expected to bring peak litigation with OpenAI and Google cases.

sources/crawl4ai-llm-web-crawler.title: Source: Crawl4AI — Open-Source LLM-Friendly Web Crawler
sources/crawl4ai-llm-web-crawler.summary: Crawl4AI (63K+ GitHub stars): open-source Playwright-based crawler producing dual markdown output (raw + BM25-filtered), with LLM/CSS/XPath extraction, anti-bot detection, and crash recovery.

sources/crunchbase-q1-2026-record-ai-fun.title: Source: Q1 2026 Shatters Venture Funding Records — AI Boom Pushes Investment to $300B
sources/crunchbase-q1-2026-record-ai-fun.summary: Q1 2026: $300B global VC ($242B in AI alone, 80% of total); OpenAI $122B, Anthropic $30B, xAI $20B; US captured 83% of global VC; extreme concentration in handful of frontier AI companies.

sources/csis-deepseek-breakthrough-redef.title: Source: DeepSeek's Latest Breakthrough Is Redefining AI Race
sources/csis-deepseek-breakthrough-redef.summary: CSIS analysis: DeepSeek R1 achieves OpenAI o1-comparable results with far less compute; 'not a Sputnik moment yet' but gap narrowing; advocates targeted export controls over blanket restrictions.

sources/dairai-llm-knowledge-bases-archi.title: Source: LLM Knowledge Bases: A System Architecture Overview
sources/dairai-llm-knowledge-bases-archi.summary: DAIR.AI Academy deep-dive on the four-phase operational cycle (ingest, compile, query, maintain) of Karpathy's LLM knowledge base system, emphasizing no vector infrastructure needed at personal scale.

sources/dario-amodei-machines-of-loving-.title: Source: Machines of Loving Grace - Dario Amodei
sources/dario-amodei-machines-of-loving-.summary: Dario Amodei's 50-page essay (October 2024) envisioning AI's transformative upside across biology, neuroscience, economic development, governance, and work -- with a 'country of geniuses in a datacenter' framework.

sources/data-deduplication-trillion-scal.title: Source: Data Deduplication at Trillion Scale
sources/data-deduplication-trillion-scal.summary: Practical guide to deduplicating LLM training data at trillion-token scale: exact matching, MinHash LSH, and semantic methods with trade-offs between precision, recall, and computational cost.

sources/databricks-agent-design-patterns.title: Source: Agent System Design Patterns (Databricks)
sources/databricks-agent-design-patterns.summary: Databricks design pattern spectrum from simple LLM+prompt through deterministic chains, single-agent, to multi-agent systems with orchestrator-worker, supervisor, and router patterns.

sources/datadog-hallucination-detection.title: Source: Detecting Hallucinations with LLM-as-a-Judge
sources/datadog-hallucination-detection.summary: Datadog's production hallucination detection system: rubric-based LLM-as-a-Judge with structured output, two-stage prompting, and semantic framing achieving 0.81-0.84 F1 on HaluBench/RAGTruth benchmarks.

sources/dclm-datacomp-language-models.title: Source: DataComp-LM — In Search of the Next Generation of Training Sets
sources/dclm-datacomp-language-models.summary: DCLM benchmark provides 240T-token Common Crawl testbed; finds fastText model-based filtering is the single most impactful curation technique, enabling a 7B model to reach 64% MMLU with 6.6x less compute than Llama 2.

sources/decodingai-second-brain-rag.title: Source: Build Your Second Brain AI Assistant — LLMs and RAG
sources/decodingai-second-brain-rag.summary: Production-grade second brain using the FTI (Feature/Training/Inference) architecture: Notion → ETL → MongoDB vector search + Llama 3.1 fine-tuning + ZenML orchestration — the enterprise-scale counterpart to Karpathy's personal approach.

sources/deepmind-genie-2.title: Source: Genie 2 — A Large-Scale Foundation World Model
sources/deepmind-genie-2.summary: DeepMind's Genie 2: diffusion-based autoregressive world model generating interactive 3D environments from single images; supports keyboard/mouse control, long-horizon memory, counterfactual trajectories, and NPC behavior modeling.

sources/deepseek-revolution-2026.title: Source: The DeepSeek Revolution
sources/deepseek-revolution-2026.summary: DeepSeek V3.2 (685B, MIT) surpassed GPT-5-High on math; Sparse Attention cuts inference costs 70%; distilled 32B variant; V4 training on Huawei Ascend; catalyzed 1,500+ Chinese open LLMs.

sources/deepset-rag-groundedness.title: Source: Measuring LLM Groundedness in RAG Systems
sources/deepset-rag-groundedness.summary: deepset's production approach to RAG groundedness: numerical scoring per response, document reference analysis for retrieval quality, statement-level citation annotation, and continuous production monitoring via observability dashboards.

sources/deepspeed-megatron-frameworks.title: Source: Utilizing Frameworks like DeepSpeed and Megatron-LM
sources/deepspeed-megatron-frameworks.summary: Detailed comparison of DeepSpeed (ZeRO Stages 1-3, Offload) and Megatron-LM (tensor/pipeline parallelism), plus their combination as Megatron-DeepSpeed for 3D parallelism training of trillion-parameter models.

sources/deloitte-physical-ai-humanoid-ro.title: Source: Physical AI and Humanoid Robots (Deloitte 2026)
sources/deloitte-physical-ai-humanoid-ro.summary: Deloitte Tech Trends 2026 deep-dive on physical AI: VLA models, onboard computing, and humanoid market projections ($30-50B by 2035); documents deployments at Waymo, Amazon, BMW; identifies sim-to-real gap, safety, and fleet orchestration as key barriers.

sources/descope-mcp-vs-function-calling.title: Source: MCP vs. Function Calling — How They Differ
sources/descope-mcp-vs-function-calling.summary: Deep comparison of MCP vs function calling across architecture, security, portability, scalability, and maintenance — concluding MCP is preferred for production/enterprise, function calling for prototypes.

sources/devin-ai-software-engineer.title: Source: Devin AI — The First Autonomous Software Engineering Agent
sources/devin-ai-software-engineer.summary: Devin by Cognition Labs: first autonomous AI software engineer, 13.86% SWE-bench at launch (vs 1.96% prior SOTA), $20/month in 2.0, with Wiki and Search features.

sources/dextralabs-claude-cursor-copilot.title: Source: Claude Code vs Cursor vs GitHub Copilot — 30-Day Comparison
sources/dextralabs-claude-cursor-copilot.summary: Practitioner 30-day head-to-head: Cursor wins on balanced IDE experience (9/10), Claude Code on deep reasoning (8.5/10 backend), Copilot on zero-friction pattern completion (8/10).

sources/differentiable-neural-computers-.title: Source: Differentiable Neural Computers (DeepMind)
sources/differentiable-neural-computers-.summary: DeepMind's overview of Differentiable Neural Computers: neural network controllers coupled to external read/write memory via differentiable attention, extending Neural Turing Machines with temporal linking and dynamic allocation — capable of learning graph navigation, multi-step reasoning, and algorithmic tasks.

sources/dit-diffusion-transformer-archit.title: Source: Diffusion Transformer (DiT) Architecture Guide
sources/dit-diffusion-transformer-archit.summary: Technical guide to DiT architecture: replaces U-Net with transformer backbone using patchification, adaLN conditioning, and VAE latent space -- achieving FID 2.27 on ImageNet 256x256, with scalable performance proven through depth/width/token increases.

sources/domain-adaptive-pretraining-dapt.title: Source: A Practical Guide to Domain-Adaptive Pretraining
sources/domain-adaptive-pretraining-dapt.summary: DAPT adds an intermediate domain-specific pretraining step between general pretraining and task fine-tuning; operates on unlabeled data; combined with TAPT yields best results.

sources/dpo-vs-ppo-comprehensive-study.title: Source: Is DPO Superior to PPO for LLM Alignment?
sources/dpo-vs-ppo-comprehensive-study.summary: Comprehensive empirical study finding PPO consistently outperforms DPO across dialogue, code generation, and RLHF testbeds -- especially on challenging tasks -- due to DPO's sensitivity to distribution shift.

sources/dsebastien-obsidian-plugins-2026.title: Source: The Best Obsidian Plugins for 2026
sources/dsebastien-obsidian-plugins-2026.summary: Comprehensive guide to 75+ Obsidian plugins organized by category — identifies Dataview, Templater, and QuickAdd as the foundational trio for power users.

sources/earley-ontology-ia-role-in-ai.title: Source: The Role of Ontology and Information Architecture in AI
sources/earley-ontology-ia-role-in-ai.summary: Earley Information Science on ontology as 'master data management for AI': knowledge model hierarchy (controlled vocabulary → thesaurus → taxonomy → ontology → knowledge graph), ontologies enable multi-parent inheritance unlike taxonomies, changes propagate automatically through associative relationships. Case study: Cleveland Museum of Art ontology for visitor analytics.

sources/eesel-confluence-notion-sharepoi.title: Source: Confluence vs Notion vs SharePoint (2026)
sources/eesel-confluence-notion-sharepoi.summary: 2026 comparison of three dominant enterprise knowledge platforms: Confluence (structured wiki + Rovo AI agents), Notion (flexible blocks + autonomous Agent), SharePoint (enterprise compliance + Copilot at $30/user extra). Notion leads AI features in base plan; Confluence best for Jira teams; SharePoint for regulated enterprises.

sources/ek-km-trends-2026.title: Source: Top Knowledge Management Trends 2026
sources/ek-km-trends-2026.summary: Enterprise Knowledge CEO Zach Wahl identifies 8 KM trends for 2026: semantic layers powering enterprise AI, boxed vs. built AI, scaling AI-ready knowledge assets, tacit knowledge capture, conversational search replacing traditional search, knowledge generation flattening, data adopting KM principles, and organizational change from AI.

sources/ek-taxonomy-ia-semantic-layer.title: Source: Taxonomy and Information Architecture for the Semantic Layer
sources/ek-taxonomy-ia-semantic-layer.summary: Enterprise Knowledge deep-dive on how taxonomy, information architecture, and ontology compose the semantic layer. Semantic layer = standardized abstraction between data repositories and front-end applications. Taxonomy provides controlled vocabulary; IA provides structural design; ontology provides cross-taxonomy relationships. Best practice: govern on W3C SKOS standards.

sources/eleutherai-rotary-embeddings.title: Source: Rotary Embeddings: A Relative Revolution
sources/eleutherai-rotary-embeddings.summary: EleutherAI's technical deep-dive into RoPE: position as rotation in complex-number embedding space, mathematical proof of relative position preservation, comparison with sinusoidal/learned/T5 alternatives, and GPT-NeoX implementation.

sources/emergehaus-test-time-compute-ove.title: Source: Test-Time Compute in Generative AI (Emerge Haus)
sources/emergehaus-test-time-compute-ove.summary: Comprehensive enterprise-oriented overview of test-time compute: System 2 analogy, AIME 9%->87.5% gains, model cascade strategy (60/30/10 split), and 12-24 month infrastructure outlook.

sources/emergentmind-llm-tutoring-soluti.title: Source: LLM-Powered Tutoring Solutions
sources/emergentmind-llm-tutoring-soluti.summary: Comprehensive survey of LLM tutoring systems: Physics-STAR (100% score increase), Tutorly (61.9% to 76.6% correctness), AgentTutor (24-30 pp advantage), covering STEM, soft skills, and teacher development — with pedagogical approaches from IRT to Bayesian mastery tracking.

sources/epoch-ai-scaling-limits-2030.title: Source: Can AI Scaling Continue Through 2030? — Epoch AI
sources/epoch-ai-scaling-limits-2030.summary: Epoch AI projects 2e29 FLOP training runs feasible by 2030 — equivalent to another GPT-2→GPT-4 jump — with power as the binding constraint, followed by chip manufacturing capacity.

sources/epoch-context-window-growth.title: Source: LLMs Now Accept Longer Inputs — Epoch AI
sources/epoch-context-window-growth.summary: Epoch AI analysis showing frontier LLM context windows growing ~30x/year since mid-2023, with effective usage growing even faster at ~250x in 9 months.

sources/eugeneyan-llm-evaluators.title: Source: Evaluating the Effectiveness of LLM-Evaluators
sources/eugeneyan-llm-evaluators.summary: Data-rich analysis of LLM-as-Judge effectiveness: GPT-4 achieves 85% agreement with humans on MT-Bench, but exhibits position bias (50-70%), verbosity bias (>90%), and self-enhancement bias (10-25%); includes mitigation strategies and alternative frameworks.

sources/euronews-ai-brain-drain-europe.title: Source: The AI Brain Drain — Why Europe Can't Keep the Talent It Trains
sources/euronews-ai-brain-drain-europe.summary: Europe has 30% more AI talent per capita than the US but net tech inflows halved (52K to 26K, 2022-2024); US salaries 30-70% higher; demand-supply ratio 3.2:1 globally; young scholars 100x more likely to leave academia for industry.

sources/evabyte-tokenization-free-model.title: Source: EvaByte — Efficient Byte-Level Language Models at Scale
sources/evabyte-tokenization-free-model.summary: EvaByte is a 6.5B tokenization-free byte-level LM matching token-based models, using multibyte prediction and EVA attention to achieve 2x faster inference with 320-token vocabulary.

sources/evidentlyai-llm-evaluation-guide.title: Source: LLM Evaluation — A Beginner's Guide
sources/evidentlyai-llm-evaluation-guide.summary: Evidently AI's practical evaluation framework: distinguishes model vs product evaluation, defines six evaluation scenarios (experiments, stress-testing, red-teaming, production monitoring, regression, guardrails), and provides a phased implementation workflow.

sources/faros-ai-coding-agents-2026.title: Source: Best AI Coding Agents for 2026
sources/faros-ai-coding-agents-2026.summary: Comprehensive 2026 review of AI coding agents: Cursor leads on flow, Claude Code on reasoning depth, Copilot on frictionless integration, with 10+ runner-ups across CLI, IDE, and autonomous categories.

sources/faros-ai-productivity-paradox.title: Source: The AI Productivity Paradox Research Report
sources/faros-ai-productivity-paradox.summary: Faros AI telemetry from 10,000+ developers reveals the paradox: 21% more tasks completed but 9% more bugs, 154% larger PRs, 91% longer reviews, and no organizational-level productivity gain.

sources/federated-wiki-cunningham.title: Source: Federated Wiki
sources/federated-wiki-cunningham.summary: Ward Cunningham's Federated Wiki: forking-based collaborative knowledge where multiple perspectives coexist ('chorus of voices') rather than converging on single consensus articles.

sources/figure-ai-humanoid-robots.title: Source: Figure AI Humanoid Robot Company
sources/figure-ai-humanoid-robots.summary: Figure AI's trajectory from $70M seed (2023) to $39B valuation (2025); three robot generations with increasing autonomy; pivoted from OpenAI partnership to proprietary Helix VLA system for high-rate robot control; BotQ facility targeting 12,000 units/year.

sources/fineweb-dataset-huggingface.title: Source: FineWeb — Decanting the Web for the Finest Text Data at Scale
sources/fineweb-dataset-huggingface.summary: HuggingFace's 15T-token open dataset from 96 CommonCrawl dumps; discovered that aggressive cross-dump deduplication can harm quality and that per-dump dedup preserves more useful data.

sources/firecrawl-web-data-api.title: Source: Firecrawl — The Web Data API for AI
sources/firecrawl-web-data-api.summary: Firecrawl converts websites into LLM-ready markdown/JSON via a single API call, handling JavaScript rendering, anti-bot bypass, and proxy rotation, with scrape/crawl/map/search/interact modes.

sources/flashattention-3-paper.title: Source: FlashAttention-3
sources/flashattention-3-paper.summary: FlashAttention-3 achieves 75% H100 utilization (up from 35%) via warp specialization, interleaved matmul/softmax, and FP8 block quantization — reaching 740 TFLOPS in FP16 and 1.2 PFLOPS in FP8.

sources/flashattention-3-tri-dao-blog.title: Source: FlashAttention-3 — Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
sources/flashattention-3-tri-dao-blog.summary: Tri Dao's blog post on FlashAttention-3: three Hopper-specific optimizations (async warp specialization, interleaved matmul/softmax, FP8 incoherent processing) achieving 740 TFLOPS FP16 (75% H100 utilization) and ~1.2 PFLOPS FP8.

sources/fli-ai-safety-index-2025.title: Source: 2025 AI Safety Index — Future of Life Institute
sources/fli-ai-safety-index-2025.summary: FLI's independent evaluation of 7 AI companies across 33 indicators in 6 domains; Anthropic leads at C+, no company above D in existential safety.

sources/flow-matching-iclr-2025.title: Source: Flow With What You Know (ICLR 2025)
sources/flow-matching-iclr-2025.summary: ICLR 2025 blog post providing physics-grounded explanation of flow matching: velocity field estimation via ODE solving, rectified flows as straight-line transport paths, reflow for few-step generation, and connection to optimal transport via Benamou-Brenier formulation.

sources/flux-architecture-demystified.title: Source: Demystifying Flux Architecture
sources/flux-architecture-demystified.summary: arXiv paper reverse-engineering FLUX.1 architecture: 19 dual-stream MMDiT blocks (separate text/image weights with joint attention) followed by single-stream blocks (shared weights), dual T5+CLIP text encoding, RoPE positional embeddings, and rectified flow velocity prediction training.

sources/flux-vs-stable-diffusion-2026.title: Source: Flux vs Stable Diffusion Technical Comparison (2026)
sources/flux-vs-stable-diffusion-2026.summary: Technical comparison: FLUX (12B params, flow matching, T5+CLIP encoding) vs Stable Diffusion (U-Net, DDPM, CLIP-only) -- FLUX achieves near-perfect typography and prompt adherence in 4-20 steps, while SD retains ecosystem advantages with extensive LoRA support.

sources/forte-building-second-brain.title: Source: Building a Second Brain — Tiago Forte
sources/forte-building-second-brain.summary: Tiago Forte's BASB methodology: CODE workflow (Capture, Organize, Distill, Express), PARA folder system (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archive), and Progressive Summarization — a complete framework for building an external digital repository that augments human cognition.

sources/free-energy-principle-unified-br.title: Source: The Free-Energy Principle — A Unified Brain Theory?
sources/free-energy-principle-unified-br.summary: Karl Friston's free-energy principle: biological systems minimize variational free energy (prediction error), unifying perception, action, learning, and attention under one mathematical framework with direct links to VAEs and generative AI.

sources/freecodecamp-local-rag-ollama.title: Source: Build Local AI with RAG using Qwen 3 and Ollama
sources/freecodecamp-local-rag-ollama.summary: Step-by-step tutorial for building a fully local RAG system: Ollama + Qwen 3 + ChromaDB + LangChain — zero cloud dependency, handles PDFs with embeddings via nomic-embed-text.

sources/frontiers-ai-lab-automation-scie.title: Source: AI, Agentic Models and Lab Automation for Scientific Discovery
sources/frontiers-ai-lab-automation-scie.summary: Hartung reviews AI's transition from 'co-pilot' interpreting knowledge to 'lab-pilot' conducting experiments — AlphaFold (Nobel Prize), halicin (novel antibiotic), ISM001-055 (first AI drug in Phase II), and autonomous laboratories.

sources/funsearch-mathematical-discovery.title: Source: FunSearch — Mathematical Discoveries Using LLMs
sources/funsearch-mathematical-discovery.summary: DeepMind's FunSearch pairs PaLM 2 with an automated evaluator in an evolutionary loop to generate interpretable code solutions — cracking the cap set problem (largest advance in 20 years) and outperforming human heuristics on bin packing.

sources/gallagher-second-brain-knowledge.title: Source: Using LLMs as a Second Brain — From Notes to Knowledge Graphs
sources/gallagher-second-brain-knowledge.summary: Practitioner account of building the Knowledge Graph Kit (MCP server): SQLite + ChromaDB graph with four node types, contrasting structure-first (graph) vs. text-first (markdown) approaches to personal knowledge management.

sources/gavel-law-firm-llm-guide-2026.title: Source: Small Law Firm AI Guide — Using LLMs in 2026
sources/gavel-law-firm-llm-guide-2026.summary: Gavel's practical guide: three primary legal LLM use cases (document summarization, drafting, research) with tools like Everlaw, Luminance, Casetext; AI adoption surged from 19% to 79% among legal professionals between 2023-2024.

sources/gemini-deep-think-scientific-dis.title: Source: Gemini Deep Think — Accelerating Mathematical and Scientific Discovery
sources/gemini-deep-think-scientific-dis.summary: Gemini Deep Think achieved IMO gold (35/42, 5/6 problems) and solved 4 open Erdos conjectures autonomously. Aletheia agent combines natural language verification, iterative revision, and web browsing. Breakthroughs span network optimization, submodular optimization, economic theory, and cosmic strings.

sources/gencast-weather-prediction.title: Source: GenCast — AI Weather Prediction with SOTA Accuracy
sources/gencast-weather-prediction.summary: DeepMind's GenCast diffusion model outperforms ECMWF's ENS on 97.2% of tested forecast combinations (99.8% beyond 36 hours). Produces 15-day ensemble forecasts in 8 minutes on a single TPU vs hours on supercomputers. Now used for humanitarian Anticipatory Action programs.

sources/github-faster-bpe-tokenizer.title: Source: GitHub's Faster BPE Tokenizer
sources/github-faster-bpe-tokenizer.summary: GitHub's open-source BPE tokenizer achieves 4x tiktoken / 10x HuggingFace speed using an Aho-Corasick automaton and incremental left-to-right encoding with linear time complexity.

sources/glean-enterprise-search-guide.title: Source: The Definitive Guide to AI-Based Enterprise Search
sources/glean-enterprise-search-guide.summary: Glean's comprehensive guide to AI enterprise search: Enterprise Graph architecture linking people/data/processes, 100+ SaaS integrations, semantic search via LLMs, permission-aware RAG, code intelligence, and agentic workflow automation. Market at $6.83B in 2025, projected $11.15B by 2030.

sources/glean-knowledge-silos-unified-se.title: Source: Knowledge Silos Are Out, Unified Search Is In
sources/glean-knowledge-silos-unified-se.summary: Glean analysis of knowledge silos: 79% of employees confirm siloed information, 68% report negative consequences. Employees lose ~3.7 hours/day to silo effects (2h redundant tasks + 1.7h repeated questions). Revenue impact up to 30%. Solution: unified enterprise search with NLP, intelligent assistants, and analytics.

sources/glenrhodes-karpathy-workflow.title: Source: Andrej Karpathy's LLM-Powered Knowledge Base Workflow
sources/glenrhodes-karpathy-workflow.summary: Technical walkthrough of Karpathy's workflow emphasizing the 'filing loop' where query results compound the knowledge base, and the product gap for non-technical users.

sources/gnome-materials-discovery.title: Source: GNoME — Millions of New Materials Discovered with Deep Learning
sources/gnome-materials-discovery.summary: DeepMind's GNoME discovered 2.2M new crystal structures using graph neural networks and active learning — equivalent to 800 years of research. 380K stable materials identified; 528 lithium-ion conductors (25x previous); 52K graphene-like compounds. Berkeley A-Lab autonomously synthesized 41+ materials.

sources/google-ai-agent-protocols.title: Source: Developer's Guide to AI Agent Protocols (Google)
sources/google-ai-agent-protocols.summary: Google's guide to six AI agent protocols: MCP (tool access), A2A (agent collaboration), UCP (commerce), AP2 (payments), A2UI (dynamic UI), AG-UI (streaming events) — all integrated via Google's ADK.

sources/google-deepmind-rt2-vla-model.title: Source: RT-2 Vision-Language-Action Model (Google DeepMind)
sources/google-deepmind-rt2-vla-model.summary: Google DeepMind's RT-2 is a pioneering VLA model that co-trains on web-scale vision-language data and robotics demonstrations; improved generalization from 32% to 62% on novel scenarios vs RT-1; introduced emergent reasoning, symbol understanding, and chain-of-thought for robotic control.

sources/google-tpu-architecture-gemini.title: Source: Google TPUs Explained — Architecture & Performance for Gemini 3
sources/google-tpu-architecture-gemini.summary: Complete TPU evolution from v1 (2015, inference-only, 92 TOPS) through Ironwood v7 (2025, 4,614 TFLOPS, 42.5 exaFLOPS per pod); Google trained Gemini 3 entirely on TPUs without GPU fallback.

sources/gpt-ner-named-entity-recognition.title: Source: GPT-NER — Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models
sources/gpt-ner-named-entity-recognition.summary: GPT-NER transforms NER from sequence labeling to text generation using special marker tokens, achieving supervised-comparable performance and excelling in few-shot settings.

sources/gqa-grouped-query-attention-over.title: Source: Grouped Query Attention (GQA) Overview
sources/gqa-grouped-query-attention-over.summary: IBM overview of Grouped Query Attention: GQA generalizes MHA and MQA by sharing KV heads across query head groups — reducing KV cache by up to 90%, 30-40% faster inference, with only 5% of pre-training compute needed to uptrain existing MHA checkpoints.

sources/graphite-ai-code-review-tools.title: Source: Best AI Pull Request Reviewers
sources/graphite-ai-code-review-tools.summary: Overview of 7 AI code review tools: Graphite Agent (96% positive rate, 55% action rate vs 49% for human reviewers), CodeRabbit (2M+ repos), Qodo (review + test generation), and 4 others.

sources/graphiti-temporal-knowledge-grap.title: Source: Graphiti — Temporal Context Graphs for AI Agents
sources/graphiti-temporal-knowledge-grap.summary: Graphiti: open-source temporal graph framework for AI agents with time-windowed facts, incremental updates, hybrid retrieval (semantic + BM25 + graph), and full provenance — the middle ground between markdown wikis and enterprise KGs.

sources/graphrag-microsoft-research.title: Source: GraphRAG — Unlocking LLM Discovery on Narrative Private Data
sources/graphrag-microsoft-research.summary: Microsoft Research's GraphRAG system uses LLM-extracted knowledge graphs with Leiden community detection and hierarchical summarization to dramatically outperform baseline RAG on holistic and cross-document queries.

sources/greptile-state-of-ai-coding-2025.title: Source: The State of AI Coding 2025
sources/greptile-state-of-ai-coding-2025.summary: Greptile's data-driven report showing AI coding tool adoption metrics: PR size up 93%, developer output tripled, CLAUDE.md in 75% of orgs, and Anthropic SDK at 124M monthly downloads by March 2026.

sources/ha-schmidhuber-world-models.title: Source: World Models (Ha & Schmidhuber, 2018)
sources/ha-schmidhuber-world-models.summary: The foundational 2018 paper: VAE + MDN-RNN + minimal controller architecture enabling agents to learn world representations and train policies 'inside a dream'; solved CarRacing-v0 with only 867 controller parameters.

sources/hao-coconut-latent-reasoning.title: Source: COCONUT - Training LLMs to Reason in Continuous Latent Space
sources/hao-coconut-latent-reasoning.summary: Introduces Chain of Continuous Thought (COCONUT), replacing token-level CoT with reasoning in hidden state space, enabling breadth-first search and more efficient inference -- a frontier in test-time compute efficiency.

sources/hbm-memory-wall-roadmap.title: Source: Scaling the Memory Wall — The Rise and Roadmap of HBM
sources/hbm-memory-wall-roadmap.summary: SemiAnalysis deep dive on HBM: the memory-Parkinson dynamic where models grow to fill available memory; HBM3e at 8 TB/s (B200); HBM4 with custom base dies; yield challenges (87% for 12-layer stacks); China's domestic HBM efforts.

sources/hbr-llms-unlock-creative-ideas.title: Source: When Used Correctly, LLMs Can Unlock More Creative Ideas
sources/hbr-llms-unlock-creative-ideas.summary: HBR research shows LLMs unlock creativity via persistence (exhaustive variations) and flexibility (distant concept combination), but warns of collective diversity narrowing when everyone uses similar tools.

sources/helpjuice-km-challenges.title: Source: Key Challenges in Knowledge Management
sources/helpjuice-km-challenges.summary: Comprehensive inventory of 8+ enterprise KM challenges: lack of executive/employee buy-in, outdated tools, unstructured processes, knowledge silos, workflow integration difficulties, scaling challenges, ROI measurement difficulty, plus information overload, tacit knowledge loss, and content deterioration.

sources/hf-ultrascale-playbook.title: Source: The Ultra-Scale Playbook — Training LLMs on GPU Clusters
sources/hf-ultrascale-playbook.summary: Hugging Face's open-source guide based on 4,000+ scaling experiments: covers 5D parallelism (DP, TP, PP, CP, EP), ZeRO, activation recomputation, gradient accumulation, and communication/computation overlap strategies.

sources/hierarchical-memory-llm-agents.title: Source: Hierarchical Memory Architectures for LLM Agents

sources/hippocampus-stability-plasticity.title: Source: Neuroplasticity Meets AI — Hippocampus-Inspired Stability-Plasticity

sources/wikipedia-semantic-web.summary: History and architecture of the Semantic Web: Tim Berners-Lee's vision for machine-readable data on the web, implemented through RDF, OWL, SPARQL, and linked data — plus its challenges with vastness, vagueness, and adoption.

sources/wikipedia-symbolic-ai.title: Source: Symbolic Artificial Intelligence (Wikipedia)
sources/wikipedia-symbolic-ai.summary: History of symbolic AI from 1948 through two AI summers and winters to modern neuro-symbolic integration, including six architectures for combining symbolic and neural approaches.

sources/wikipedia-vibe-coding.title: Source: Vibe Coding (Wikipedia)
sources/wikipedia-vibe-coding.summary: Comprehensive Wikipedia overview of vibe coding -- Karpathy's February 2025 coinage for natural-language-driven development -- covering origins, adoption, security concerns, code quality issues, and its evolution into agentic engineering by 2026.

sources/willison-llm-schemas-structured-.title: Source: Structured Data Extraction from Unstructured Content Using LLM Schemas
sources/willison-llm-schemas-structured-.summary: Simon Willison's LLM 0.23 introduces schema-based structured extraction — the 'single most commercially valuable LLM application' — with FSM-guaranteed JSON output across all major providers.

sources/winder-token-count-practical-gui.title: Source: Calculating LLM Token Counts — A Practical Guide
sources/winder-token-count-practical-gui.summary: Practical guide to counting tokens for LLM APIs using tiktoken, AutoTokenizer, and SentenceTransformers, with cost optimization strategies and language-specific token count variability.

sources/wisdom-of-the-crowd.title: Source: Wisdom of the Crowd
sources/wisdom-of-the-crowd.summary: Comprehensive overview of crowd wisdom: Galton's ox experiment, Surowiecki's conditions (diversity, independence, decentralization, aggregation), Page's diversity prediction theorem, and digital-era challenges.

sources/wolfe-direct-preference-optimiza.title: Source: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) - Deep Learning Focus
sources/wolfe-direct-preference-optimiza.summary: Cameron Wolfe's deep technical dive into DPO's mathematical derivation showing how it solves the RLHF objective in closed form, eliminating reward models and RL entirely through implicit reward learning.

sources/wolfe-llm-summarization-evolutio.title: Source: Summarization and the Evolution of LLMs
sources/wolfe-llm-summarization-evolutio.summary: Cameron Wolfe traces how summarization research (extractive vs. abstractive) led to RLHF and modern LLM alignment, revealing that LLMs are more extractive in practice than theory suggests.

sources/wolfe-reward-models-llm.title: Source: Reward Models for LLM Alignment
sources/wolfe-reward-models-llm.summary: Cameron Wolfe's technical deep-dive into reward model architecture, training, types (classifier, LLM-as-judge, DPO implicit, ORM, PRM), challenges (reward hacking, distribution mismatch), and best practices from RewardBench.

sources/wolfe-rlaif-reinforcement-learni.title: Source: RLAIF - Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback
sources/wolfe-rlaif-reinforcement-learni.summary: Cameron Wolfe's technical overview of RLAIF showing how AI-generated preference labels achieve parity with human labels at lower cost, with connections to Constitutional AI and scalable oversight.

sources/world-models-race-2026.title: Source: World Models Race 2026 — LeCun, DeepMind, NVIDIA
sources/world-models-race-2026.summary: Comprehensive overview of the 2026 world models race: AMI Labs ($1B seed), DeepMind Genie 3 (real-time 24fps), NVIDIA Cosmos (2M downloads), World Labs Marble ($230M); over $1.3B in funding flowing into the paradigm.

sources/wu-inference-scaling-laws.title: Source: Inference Scaling Laws -- Compute-Optimal Inference for LLM Problem-Solving
sources/wu-inference-scaling-laws.summary: ICLR 2025 paper establishing inference scaling laws: log10(C) = 1.19*log10(N) + 2.03, showing Llemma-7B with tree search outperforms Llemma-34B -- inference compute is an independent optimizable axis.

sources/xenoss-vector-db-comparison.title: Source: Pinecone vs Qdrant vs Weaviate
sources/xenoss-vector-db-comparison.summary: Detailed comparison of the three leading vector databases: Pinecone (managed, compliance-first), Qdrant (Rust-based, feature-rich), and Weaviate (highest QPS at 791, native hybrid search).

sources/yao-tree-of-thoughts.title: Source: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
sources/yao-tree-of-thoughts.summary: NeurIPS 2023 paper introducing Tree of Thoughts (ToT), a framework that generalizes CoT by exploring multiple reasoning paths with search algorithms, achieving 74% on Game of 24 vs. CoT's 4%.

sources/zettelkasten-de-introduction.title: Source: Introduction to the Zettelkasten Method
sources/zettelkasten-de-introduction.summary: Comprehensive Zettelkasten guide from zettelkasten.de: three foundational traits (hypertextual, atomic, personal), anatomy of a Zettel (ID, body, references), the connection mechanism with link context, structure notes, and digital implementation guidance.

sources/zhang-test-time-scaling-survey.title: Source: What, How, Where, and How Well? A Survey on Test-Time Scaling in LLMs
sources/zhang-test-time-scaling-survey.summary: Definitive 2025 survey organizing test-time scaling along four dimensions (what/how/where/how well), cataloguing 30+ techniques from parallel sampling to internal scaling, establishing the field's taxonomy.

sources/zhuo-conversational-interfaces.title: Source: Conversational Interfaces — The Good, the Ugly & the Billion-Dollar Opportunity
sources/zhuo-conversational-interfaces.summary: Julie Zhuo argues chat interfaces were a breakthrough for accessibility but create five critical UX problems; the real opportunity is AI-powered personalization of how content is presented.

sources/zilliz-function-calling-vs-mcp-v.title: Source: Function Calling vs. MCP vs. A2A — Developer's Guide
sources/zilliz-function-calling-vs-mcp-v.summary: Three-way comparison of function calling, MCP, and A2A — showing they operate at different architectural layers and recommending a layered approach combining all three.

concepts/3d-parallelism.title: 3D Parallelism
concepts/3d-parallelism.summary: Combining data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism in a topology-aware configuration: TP within nodes (NVLink), PP across nodes (InfiniBand), DP across the cluster. The standard approach for frontier LLM training.

concepts/5d-parallelism.title: 5D Parallelism
concepts/5d-parallelism.summary: Extension of 3D parallelism (DP+TP+PP) with Context Parallelism (splitting sequence length) and Expert Parallelism (distributing MoE experts) — the current state-of-the-art for training frontier models like DeepSeek-V3.

concepts/agent-frameworks.title: Agent Frameworks
concepts/agent-frameworks.summary: The landscape of LLM agent development frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, and 2025 newcomers (agent-lightning, hermes-agent, superpowers), consolidating around distinct use cases.

concepts/agent-memory.title: Agent Memory
concepts/agent-memory.summary: Short-term and long-term memory systems for LLM agents: from simple conversation history to learned, adaptive memory management via AgeMem's tool-based RL approach.

concepts/agent-orchestration.title: Agent Orchestration
concepts/agent-orchestration.summary: Patterns for coordinating multiple LLM agents: orchestrator-worker (most common in production), supervisor, and router patterns with registry/state-store/supervisor components.

concepts/agent-planning.title: Agent Planning
concepts/agent-planning.summary: How LLM agents decompose complex goals into executable subtask sequences using Chain of Thought, Tree of Thought, and task decomposition, with feedback loops via ReAct and Reflexion.

concepts/agent-to-agent-protocol.title: Agent-to-Agent Protocol (A2A)
concepts/agent-to-agent-protocol.summary: Google's protocol for inter-agent collaboration: agents publish Agent Cards for capability discovery, delegate tasks dynamically, and coordinate in real time. Complementary to MCP (tools) — A2A handles 'expertise' and agent-to-agent communication.

concepts/agentic-coding.title: Agentic Coding
concepts/agentic-coding.summary: AI agents that autonomously write, test, debug, and ship code — from Devin's 2024 debut to Claude Code's $2.5B revenue, transforming developers from coders to coordinators.

concepts/agentic-knowledge-management.title: Agentic Knowledge Management
concepts/agentic-knowledge-management.summary: The next evolution of PKM: AI agents that proactively monitor knowledge bases, understand user context and goals, propose actions autonomously, and execute with human approval — transforming the knowledge base into shared cognitive infrastructure between human and AI.

concepts/agentic-rag.title: Agentic RAG
concepts/agentic-rag.summary: The current frontier of RAG: autonomous agents orchestrate retrieval through reflection, planning, and tool use — dynamically adapting pipelines with routers, graders, generators, and hallucination checkers.

concepts/agentic-workflow-patterns.title: Agentic Workflow Patterns
concepts/agentic-workflow-patterns.summary: Five canonical workflow patterns for AI agents (Anthropic): prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, orchestrator-workers, evaluator-optimizer — plus the distinction between deterministic workflows and dynamic agents.

concepts/agentic-workflows.title: Agentic Workflows
concepts/agentic-workflows.summary: The paradigm of prompting LLMs iteratively through multi-step workflows with reflection, tool use, planning, and multi-agent collaboration — architecture matters more than model size.

concepts/ai-accelerators.title: AI Accelerators
concepts/ai-accelerators.summary: Purpose-built hardware for neural network computation — from GPUs with tensor cores to custom ASICs; spectrum ranges from NVIDIA's general-purpose Blackwell (1800 TFLOPS) to Taalas's model-weights-in-silicon (17,000 tok/s, single model only).

concepts/ai-agent-integration-patterns.title: AI Agent Integration Patterns
concepts/ai-agent-integration-patterns.summary: Five patterns for connecting AI agents to external systems, from simplest to most complex: direct API calls, function calling, MCP gateway, unified API, and A2A protocols — with decision matrix across auth, governance, and maintenance.

concepts/ai-alignment-democratic.title: Democratic AI Alignment
concepts/ai-alignment-democratic.summary: Using collective intelligence mechanisms — citizens' assemblies, quadratic voting, liquid democracy, deliberative platforms — to align AI systems with collective values rather than designer preferences or market incentives alone.

concepts/ai-alignment.title: AI Alignment
concepts/ai-alignment.summary: The technical challenge of ensuring AI systems pursue the goals their operators intend — encompassing RLHF, Constitutional AI, scalable oversight, and the detection of deceptive alignment.

concepts/ai-arms-race.title: AI Arms Race
concepts/ai-arms-race.summary: The escalating competition between nations to develop and deploy military AI systems — the US has operational combat experience (Operation Epic Fury), China pursues fully autonomous combat decisions, and the PLA's critical gap is zero combat testing since 1979.

concepts/ai-chip-export-controls.title: AI Chip Export Controls
concepts/ai-chip-export-controls.summary: US restrictions on advanced AI chip exports to China — the most potent policy lever in the AI race; US chips 5-17x more powerful than China's best; policy oscillating between restriction and relaxation under Trump administration.

concepts/ai-code-generation.title: AI Code Generation
concepts/ai-code-generation.summary: LLMs generating source code from natural language or existing code context -- from autocomplete to autonomous issue resolution -- now producing ~46% of all committed code with SWE-bench scores reaching 80.8%.

concepts/ai-code-review.title: AI Code Review
concepts/ai-code-review.summary: AI-powered pull request review tools that analyze code for bugs, security, and style — now achieving higher action rates (55%) than human reviewers (49%), and identified as the key bottleneck in the AI productivity paradox.

concepts/ai-coding-assistants.title: AI Coding Assistants
concepts/ai-coding-assistants.summary: The landscape of LLM-powered developer tools — from inline autocomplete to autonomous agents — organized into five tiers: code review, IDE assistants, cloud-specific, autonomous agents, and low-code builders.

concepts/ai-content-verification.title: AI Content Verification
concepts/ai-content-verification.summary: Methods for verifying the accuracy and trustworthiness of AI-generated content — spanning automated detection, human fact-checking, multi-model peer review, and source attribution.

concepts/ai-creativity-paradox.title: AI Creativity Paradox
concepts/ai-creativity-paradox.summary: The empirically demonstrated paradox that generative AI improves individual creative output (especially for less creative individuals) while reducing the collective diversity of novel content — with implications for research, education, law, and all knowledge domains.

concepts/ai-drug-discovery.title: AI Drug Discovery
concepts/ai-drug-discovery.summary: AI is reshaping drug discovery with 173+ programs in clinical development, 80-90% Phase I success rates (vs 52% historical), and 30-month target-to-trial timelines (vs 6-8 years). 2026 Phase III results will determine if the promise is real.

concepts/ai-for-scientific-discovery.title: AI for Scientific Discovery
concepts/ai-for-scientific-discovery.summary: AI is having its most transformative real-world impact in scientific discovery — from AlphaFold (protein structure), GNoME (2.2M materials), GenCast (weather), to theorem proving and self-driving labs. The 2024 Nobel Prizes in both Physics and Chemistry went to AI researchers.
links: concepts/nobel-prizes-ai-2024|Nobel Prizes in both Physics and Chemistry

concepts/ai-generated-content-risks.title: AI-Generated Content Risks
concepts/ai-generated-content-risks.summary: AI-generated content in collaborative knowledge systems creates risks beyond simple hallucination: subtle misattribution (real sources cited for claims they don't contain), content homogenization, reduced human contributions, and overwhelmed verification capacity.

concepts/ai-geopolitics.title: AI Geopolitics
concepts/ai-geopolitics.summary: The intersection of AI development with international power dynamics — encompassing the US-China competition, export controls, regulatory divergence, military AI, talent flows, and sovereignty drives shaping AI's global trajectory.

concepts/ai-governance.title: AI Governance
concepts/ai-governance.summary: Regulatory and organizational frameworks for responsible AI development and deployment — centered on the EU AI Act (binding), NIST AI RMF (voluntary), and ISO/IEC 42001 (certifiable), with enforcement beginning August 2026.

concepts/ai-hardware-landscape.title: AI Hardware Landscape
concepts/ai-hardware-landscape.summary: The competitive dynamics of AI compute hardware in 2026: NVIDIA dominance (80%+ market share) challenged by hyperscaler custom silicon (Google TPU, Amazon Trainium), specialized inference ASICs (Cerebras, Groq, Etched), and emerging paradigms (photonic, quantum).

concepts/ai-materials-science.title: AI for Materials Science
concepts/ai-materials-science.summary: AI is revolutionizing materials discovery: GNoME found 2.2M new crystals (800 years equivalent), including 528 lithium-ion conductors and 52K graphene-like compounds. Autonomous labs like A-Lab physically synthesize AI-predicted materials, closing the prediction-to-synthesis loop.

concepts/ai-mathematical-reasoning.title: AI for Mathematical Reasoning
concepts/ai-mathematical-reasoning.summary: AI mathematical reasoning has advanced from struggling with arithmetic to winning IMO gold medals (Gemini Deep Think, DeepSeekMath-V2), solving open Erdos conjectures, breaking 56-year records (AlphaEvolve on matrix multiplication), and producing genuine mathematical discoveries (FunSearch on cap sets).

concepts/ai-native-design.title: AI-Native Design
concepts/ai-native-design.summary: Products where AI is fundamental, not supplementary — built from day one with models, data pipelines, and learning systems as core components; evaluated across five dimensions: Design, Data, Domain Expertise, Dynamism, Distribution.

concepts/ai-native-education.title: AI-Native Education
concepts/ai-native-education.summary: Education redesigned around AI from the ground up: human instructors create curriculum, AI teaching assistants provide personalized guidance at scale — Karpathy's Eureka Labs vision.

concepts/ai-pair-programming.title: AI Pair Programming
concepts/ai-pair-programming.summary: The practice of collaborating with AI as a programming partner — treating it as a capable but fallible junior developer requiring clear direction, incremental tasking, and constant review.

concepts/ai-productivity-paradox.title: AI Productivity Paradox
concepts/ai-productivity-paradox.summary: The disconnect between perceived and measured AI productivity: developers believe AI makes them faster, but rigorous studies show 19% slowdown for experienced developers, and organizations see no net delivery improvement despite 84% adoption.

concepts/ai-protein-structure-prediction.title: AI Protein Structure Prediction
concepts/ai-protein-structure-prediction.summary: Predicting 3D protein structure from amino acid sequence — solved by AlphaFold 2 at CASP 14 (2020). AlphaFold 3 extends to all biomolecular interactions (76% accuracy on ligand binding). 200M+ structures released, 3M+ researchers served, Nobel Prize awarded 2024.

concepts/ai-research-assistants.title: AI Research Assistants
concepts/ai-research-assistants.summary: The 2026 AI research tool ecosystem: Perplexity (citation search), Elicit (literature reviews), Consensus (science validation), Scite (1.2B citation statements), Research Rabbit (free network mapping) — effective researchers compose multi-tool workflows rather than relying on single assistants.

concepts/ai-safety-benchmarks.title: AI Safety Benchmarks
concepts/ai-safety-benchmarks.summary: Standardized evaluations for measuring AI system safety — from jailbreak resistance (HarmBench) and bias (BBQ) to hallucination detection (TruthfulQA, Mu-SHROOM) and organizational safety practices (FLI Safety Index).

concepts/ai-safety.title: AI Safety
concepts/ai-safety.summary: The field ensuring AI systems do not cause unintended harm — spanning technical robustness, alignment, evaluation, governance, and societal risk mitigation.

concepts/ai-scientific-discovery.title: AI for Scientific Discovery
concepts/ai-scientific-discovery.summary: AI's transition from 'co-pilot' interpreting knowledge to 'lab-pilot' conducting experiments — AlphaFold (Nobel Prize), halicin (novel antibiotic), ISM001-055 (first AI drug Phase II), GNoME (380K crystals), and autonomous laboratories.

concepts/ai-sovereignty.title: AI Sovereignty
concepts/ai-sovereignty.summary: A nation's ability to develop and control its own AI capabilities — 71% of executives call it an 'existential concern'; requires sovereignty across energy, compute, data, models, cloud, and applications; $600B market opportunity by 2030.

concepts/ai-ux-design-patterns.title: AI UX Design Patterns
concepts/ai-ux-design-patterns.summary: Emerging taxonomy of 57+ interaction patterns for AI products, organized into Wayfinders, Prompt Actions, Tuners, Governors, Trust Builders, and Identifiers — covering the full lifecycle from onboarding to oversight.

concepts/anti-bot-evasion.title: Anti-Bot Evasion
concepts/anti-bot-evasion.summary: Techniques for avoiding web scraping detection: IP rotation, header randomization, behavior mimicry, session persistence, and headless browser stealth — balanced against ethical obligations to respect site owners.

concepts/apple-silicon-inference.title: Apple Silicon Inference
concepts/apple-silicon-inference.summary: Apple Silicon's unified memory architecture makes Macs uniquely suited for local LLM inference; MLX leads throughput (<14B models), llama.cpp handles larger models via CPU+GPU splitting.

concepts/approximate-nearest-neighbor-se.title: Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search (ANN)
concepts/approximate-nearest-neighbor-se.summary: Trading small amounts of accuracy for dramatic speed gains when searching high-dimensional vector spaces: the foundational tradeoff underlying all vector database indexing.

concepts/attention-mechanisms.title: Attention Mechanisms
concepts/attention-mechanisms.summary: The family of mechanisms enabling neural networks to dynamically focus on relevant parts of their input — from Bahdanau's 2014 additive attention through the 2017 Transformer's scaled dot-product self-attention to modern variants (flash, linear, sparse, grouped query).

concepts/attention-sinks.title: Attention Sinks
concepts/attention-sinks.summary: The phenomenon where initial tokens in a sequence receive disproportionately high attention scores regardless of semantic content — caused by softmax's sum-to-one constraint forcing excess attention weight onto positionally-biased anchors.

concepts/augmented-llm.title: Augmented LLM
concepts/augmented-llm.summary: The foundational building block of agentic AI: an LLM enhanced with retrieval, tool integration, and memory — capable of independently generating search queries, selecting tools, and retaining information.

concepts/automated-fact-checking.title: Automated Fact-Checking
concepts/automated-fact-checking.summary: Automated verification of LLM-generated claims against external knowledge: claim decomposition, evidence retrieval, verdict generation — using frameworks like OpenFactCheck, FIRE, and VERIFAID to complement faithfulness checking.

concepts/automated-testing-for-ai-code.title: Automated Testing for AI-Generated Code
concepts/automated-testing-for-ai-code.summary: The emerging discipline of validating AI-generated code through agentic test generation, self-healing test suites, and AI-on-AI review -- critical because 60% of AI-generated code requires intervention and review times have ballooned 91%.

concepts/automated-wiki-creation.title: Automated Wiki Creation
concepts/automated-wiki-creation.summary: STORM's approach: single-shot, multi-perspective Wikipedia-style article generation from web search using simulated expert conversations and outline-first synthesis — contrasting with Karpathy's incremental, accumulating KB model.

concepts/batch-inference.title: Batch Inference
concepts/batch-inference.summary: Processing LLM requests in bulk rather than real-time: API batch endpoints offer 50% price discounts for jobs that can wait hours, while server-side continuous batching achieves 23x throughput improvement.

concepts/benchmark-contamination.title: Benchmark Contamination
concepts/benchmark-contamination.summary: When benchmark evaluation datasets leak into LLM training data, inflating performance scores — a fundamental unsolved problem with an inherent fidelity-resistance tradeoff in mitigation strategies.

concepts/benchmark-saturation.title: Benchmark Saturation
concepts/benchmark-saturation.summary: The crisis of LLM benchmark reliability: 'benchmaxxing' (optimizing for leaderboard scores), training data contamination, and MMLU saturation above 90% mean benchmark numbers are no longer trustworthy indicators of capability.

concepts/bi-encoder-vs-cross-encoder.title: Bi-Encoder vs Cross-Encoder
concepts/bi-encoder-vs-cross-encoder.summary: The two fundamental architectures for neural text matching: bi-encoders encode texts independently for fast retrieval but lose information; cross-encoders process pairs jointly for high accuracy but cannot scale to full collections.

concepts/blank-page-problem.title: Blank Page Problem
concepts/blank-page-problem.summary: The UX failure where a blank chat box provides no affordance for what an AI system can do, putting the burden on users to discover capabilities — solved by Wayfinder patterns like Suggestions, Templates, and Gallery.

concepts/bm25.title: BM25
concepts/bm25.summary: Best Matching 25: the standard probabilistic ranking algorithm for keyword search, building on TF-IDF with term frequency saturation and document length normalization.

concepts/boilerplate-removal.title: Boilerplate Removal
concepts/boilerplate-removal.summary: The sub-problem of content extraction focused on removing navigation, ads, footers, sidebars, and other non-content elements from web pages — solved via DOM scoring (Readability), block classification (jusText), or neural filtering (Reader-LM).

concepts/bradley-terry-model.title: Bradley-Terry Model
concepts/bradley-terry-model.summary: The statistical model underlying both RLHF reward models and DPO: converts pairwise preference comparisons into probability estimates via the sigmoid of reward differences.

concepts/brain-inspired-ai.title: Brain-Inspired AI
concepts/brain-inspired-ai.summary: AI systems designed using principles from biological brains — including sparse coding, complementary learning systems, predictive processing, sleep-like consolidation, and spiking neural networks — addressing limitations of conventional deep learning.

concepts/byte-level-models.title: Byte-Level Models (Tokenization-Free)
concepts/byte-level-models.summary: Language models that process raw UTF-8 bytes instead of subword tokens, eliminating tokenization entirely — exemplified by EvaByte (6.5B) and Byte Latent Transformer, now matching tokenized models at scale.

concepts/byte-pair-encoding.title: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE)
concepts/byte-pair-encoding.summary: The most popular tokenization algorithm for LLMs — iteratively merges the most frequent adjacent byte/character pairs to build a subword vocabulary, used by GPT, Llama, Gemma, and Qwen.

concepts/cache-augmented-generation.title: Cache-Augmented Generation (CAG)
concepts/cache-augmented-generation.summary: A RAG alternative that preloads all documents into the LLM's KV cache at once, eliminating retrieval entirely — 10x faster with higher accuracy on small knowledge bases, but limited to manageable corpus sizes.

concepts/calibrated-uncertainty.title: Calibrated Uncertainty
concepts/calibrated-uncertainty.summary: The strategic shift from pursuing 'zero hallucinations' to building AI systems that transparently signal doubt, refuse when uncertain, and produce confidence-calibrated outputs.

concepts/catastrophic-forgetting.title: Catastrophic Forgetting
concepts/catastrophic-forgetting.summary: Models losing previously learned knowledge when fine-tuned on new data — mitigated by PEFT (LoRA), regularization (EWC), experience replay, parameter isolation, and careful learning rate selection.

concepts/causal-attention.title: Causal Attention
concepts/causal-attention.summary: Masked self-attention that restricts each position to attend only to previous positions, enabling autoregressive generation in decoder-only models like GPT and Llama.

concepts/chain-of-thought-prompting.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
concepts/chain-of-thought-prompting.summary: Wei et al. (2022) technique that enables complex reasoning by having LLMs decompose problems into intermediate steps — the single most impactful prompting technique for reasoning tasks.

concepts/chain-of-thought.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
concepts/chain-of-thought.summary: A prompting technique that elicits step-by-step reasoning in LLMs by providing worked exemplars or instructions like 'think step by step,' dramatically improving performance on arithmetic, commonsense, and symbolic reasoning tasks at 100B+ parameter scale.

concepts/cheap-ontology.title: Cheap Ontology
concepts/cheap-ontology.summary: Pebblous framing: LLM wikis replace $10M–$20M enterprise knowledge graphs using only markdown files, LLM APIs, and natural-language schema instructions — democratizing what was once exclusive ontology engineering expertise.

concepts/chinchilla-scaling-laws.title: Chinchilla Scaling Laws
concepts/chinchilla-scaling-laws.summary: DeepMind's 2022 finding that compute-optimal LLM training requires ~20 tokens per parameter — overturning GPT-3-era wisdom of scaling parameters over data. Post-Chinchilla, the industry shifted further to overtrained small models (Llama 3: 1,875:1) for inference efficiency.

concepts/chunking-strategies.title: Chunking Strategies
concepts/chunking-strategies.summary: How text is split into segments for embedding and retrieval in RAG: from simple fixed-size splitting (512 tokens, 10-20% overlap) to semantic, hierarchical, and agentic approaches that align chunk boundaries with meaning.

concepts/claim-extraction.title: Claim Extraction and Fact Decomposition
concepts/claim-extraction.summary: Breaking complex LLM outputs into atomic, independently verifiable claims — essential for fact-checking, wiki quality assurance, and preventing hallucination propagation.

concepts/claude-model-family-evolution.title: Claude Model Family Evolution
concepts/claude-model-family-evolution.summary: Complete timeline of Claude model releases from Claude 1 (March 2023) through Claude 4.6 (February 2026), tracking the expansion of context windows (9K to 1M), capabilities, and pricing.

concepts/colbert-late-interaction.title: ColBERT and Late Interaction
concepts/colbert-late-interaction.summary: A retrieval paradigm between bi-encoders and cross-encoders: encode queries and documents independently at the token level, then score via MaxSim — achieving near-cross-encoder accuracy at orders of magnitude less compute.

concepts/colbert.title: ColBERT (Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT)
concepts/colbert.summary: A retrieval model that keeps per-token embeddings and uses MaxSim scoring — 100x faster than cross-encoders with comparable accuracy, strong zero-shot generalization, and multimodal extensions (ColPali, ColQwen).

concepts/collaborative-knowledge-buildin.title: Collaborative Knowledge Building
concepts/collaborative-knowledge-buildin.summary: Structured group processes for creating shared knowledge — ranging from Wikipedia's adversarial-cooperative editing to federated multi-perspective systems — now being transformed by AI that serves as both participant and infrastructure.

concepts/collaborative-ux.title: Collaborative UX
concepts/collaborative-ux.summary: Microsoft's UX framework for productive human-AI interaction: tight input-output feedback loops, prompt/output history, appropriate friction at key moments, fact-checking through citations, and editable outputs — users guide AI toward their goals through iterative collaboration.

concepts/collective-intelligence.title: Collective Intelligence
concepts/collective-intelligence.summary: The capacity of groups to outperform individuals through diverse, independent contributions aggregated via structured mechanisms — now being fundamentally reshaped by AI.

concepts/compute-optimal-training.title: Compute-Optimal Training
concepts/compute-optimal-training.summary: Allocating a fixed compute budget optimally between model size and training data — Chinchilla showed equal scaling is optimal, but modern practice shifts toward inference-optimal overtraining of smaller models.

concepts/compute-scaling.title: Compute Scaling
concepts/compute-scaling.summary: The multi-dimensional landscape of AI scaling: pre-training scaling shows diminishing returns, but test-time compute and algorithmic efficiency open new dimensions — constrained by power, chips, data, and capital.

concepts/constitutional-ai.title: Constitutional AI (CAI)
concepts/constitutional-ai.summary: Anthropic's approach to aligning AI using a written set of principles (a constitution) that enables AI self-critique, self-revision, and AI-generated preference labels -- reducing reliance on human labelers while producing harmless yet non-evasive assistants.

concepts/content-extraction.title: Content Extraction
concepts/content-extraction.summary: The discipline of extracting meaningful content from messy web pages — from DOM-scoring heuristics (Readability) through hybrid algorithms (Trafilatura) to neural models (Reader-LM) — the critical first step in any knowledge base ingest pipeline.

concepts/context-compression.title: Context Compression
concepts/context-compression.summary: Techniques for reducing token count while preserving information: hard prompts (LLMLingua, 20x), soft prompts (480x), structured pruning (Provence, 95%), and hierarchical summarization.

concepts/context-engineering.title: Context Engineering
concepts/context-engineering.summary: The systems discipline of managing everything an LLM encounters during inference — successor to prompt engineering, credited to Karpathy (2024-2025).

concepts/context-windows.title: Context Windows
concepts/context-windows.summary: The fixed-size token buffer an LLM can process in a single inference call; growing ~30x/year but effective utilization lags behind raw capacity.

concepts/continued-pretraining.title: Continued Pretraining
concepts/continued-pretraining.summary: Extending a model's pretraining phase on new corpora (domain text, synthetic data, or instruction data) to broaden or specialize its knowledge before task-specific fine-tuning.

concepts/continuous-batching.title: Continuous Batching
concepts/continuous-batching.summary: Iteration-level scheduling where completed sequences are immediately replaced with new requests, achieving 23x throughput and 90%+ GPU utilization versus 40% in naive static batching.

concepts/conversational-ui-vs-structured.title: Conversational UI vs Structured UI
concepts/conversational-ui-vs-structured.summary: Chat interfaces achieve 70% of tasks via accessibility but fail at refinement; the best AI products use hybrid approaches — conversation for intent and ideation, structured UI for iteration and precision.

concepts/copilot-pattern.title: Copilot Pattern
concepts/copilot-pattern.summary: The dominant AI product architecture where AI functions as an intelligent assistant working alongside humans — the human is the pilot, AI is the copilot — with three focus variants: Immersive, Assistive, and Embedded.

concepts/copyright-and-training-data.title: Copyright and Training Data
concepts/copyright-and-training-data.summary: The evolving legal landscape around using copyrighted works for AI training — emerging US consensus that general-purpose training is 'highly transformative' (fair use), but significant uncertainty remains with cases involving OpenAI and Google expected in 2026.

concepts/corrective-rag.title: Corrective RAG (CRAG)
concepts/corrective-rag.summary: A RAG enhancement that evaluates retrieval quality via a lightweight evaluator, falls back to web search when vectorstore results are poor, and refines knowledge by grading individual document strips.

concepts/cross-attention.title: Cross-Attention
concepts/cross-attention.summary: Attention mechanism where queries come from one sequence and keys/values from another, enabling encoder-decoder models and multimodal fusion.

concepts/data-deduplication.title: Data Deduplication
concepts/data-deduplication.summary: Removing duplicate and near-duplicate documents from LLM training data at trillion-token scale using exact matching, MinHash LSH, or semantic methods — essential for preventing wasted compute, memorization, and evaluation leakage.

concepts/data-parallelism.title: Data Parallelism
concepts/data-parallelism.summary: The simplest distributed training strategy: replicate the full model on each GPU, split input batches, compute gradients independently, then synchronize via all-reduce. Extended by ZeRO to eliminate memory redundancy.

concepts/data-quality-bottleneck.title: Data Quality Bottleneck
concepts/data-quality-bottleneck.summary: In LLM knowledge base pipelines, data quality at the raw input stage — not model capability — is the decisive factor: low-quality ingestion cascades into contaminated wiki content and flawed fine-tuning.

concepts/developer-experience-ai.title: Developer Experience with AI
concepts/developer-experience-ai.summary: How AI tools reshape the daily developer workflow — from subjective perception (feeling faster) vs objective measurement (often slower), to the shift from coder to architect/reviewer, and the 10 DX requirements for agentic IDEs.

concepts/diffusion-models.title: Diffusion Models
concepts/diffusion-models.summary: The dominant generative framework (2020-2026) that produces data by learning to reverse a gradual noise-addition process, surpassing GANs and VAEs across image, video, audio, and 3D generation -- now evolving toward flow matching and transformer backbones.

concepts/diffusion-transformer.title: Diffusion Transformer (DiT)
concepts/diffusion-transformer.summary: Architecture replacing U-Net with transformer backbone for diffusion models -- using patchification, self-attention, and adaLN conditioning to achieve predictable scaling: DiT-XL/2 achieves FID 2.27 on ImageNet 256x256, and the design underpins FLUX, SD3, and Sora.

concepts/digital-commons-governance.title: Digital Commons Governance
concepts/digital-commons-governance.summary: The institutional frameworks governing shared digital knowledge resources — copyleft licensing, community norms, foundation oversight — now requiring redesign as AI extracts value from and potentially degrades the commons.

concepts/digital-garden.title: Digital Garden
concepts/digital-garden.summary: A philosophy of public knowledge-sharing that rejects chronological blogging in favor of continuously evolving, densely linked notes organized by topological relationships — featuring six core patterns including learning in public, epistemic status markers, and independent ownership.

concepts/distributed-training.title: Distributed Training
concepts/distributed-training.summary: Splitting LLM training workloads across hundreds or thousands of GPUs using parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, context, expert) to make training feasible within reasonable time and cost constraints.

concepts/document-ai-ocr.title: Document AI and OCR
concepts/document-ai-ocr.summary: Evolution from character-level OCR (~85% accuracy) to AI-powered document intelligence (99%+) via VLMs; LLMs now rival or exceed specialized OCR engines on complex layouts.

concepts/document-chunking-strategies.title: Document Chunking Strategies
concepts/document-chunking-strategies.summary: Techniques for splitting documents into retrieval-optimized segments: fixed-size (simplest), recursive, semantic boundary, sliding window, context-aware, adaptive (ML-based), and metadata-enriched — with 18-40% accuracy improvements from semantic chunking.

concepts/document-processing-pipeline.title: Document Processing Pipeline
concepts/document-processing-pipeline.summary: The multi-stage system that converts raw unstructured documents into structured, AI-ready data: acquire → parse → chunk → enrich → embed → store, with quality validation at each stage.

concepts/domain-adaptive-pretraining.title: Domain-Adaptive Pretraining (DAPT)
concepts/domain-adaptive-pretraining.summary: Intermediate pretraining step on unlabeled domain text between general pretraining and task fine-tuning — requires no labeled data and consistently improves downstream performance.

concepts/dpo.title: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
concepts/dpo.summary: A reward-free alignment method that solves the RLHF objective in closed form, optimizing an implicit reward embedded in the policy itself via a simple binary cross-entropy loss over preference pairs.

concepts/edge-inference.title: Edge Inference (On-Device LLMs)
concepts/edge-inference.summary: Running LLMs directly on mobile devices and edge hardware: sub-1B to 3B models with 4-bit quantization achieve <20ms/token latency — 10-25x faster than cloud roundtrips — with zero data transmission and zero API cost.

concepts/embodied-ai.title: Embodied AI
concepts/embodied-ai.summary: AI agents with physical instantiation that learn through interaction with the world — requiring the perception-modeling-decision loop where world models bridge multimodal sensing with executable actions; advancing via sim-to-real transfer and self-supervised video pretraining.

concepts/embodied-intelligence.title: Embodied Intelligence
concepts/embodied-intelligence.summary: The paradigm of AI systems that perceive, reason about, and physically act in the real world — bridging the gap between digital intelligence and physical interaction through integrated perception, planning, and motor control.

concepts/emergent-abilities.title: Emergent Abilities of Large Language Models
concepts/emergent-abilities.summary: Capabilities absent in smaller LLMs that appear suddenly at scale -- including chain-of-thought reasoning, in-context learning, and multi-step arithmetic -- subject to debate about whether the phase transitions are genuine or measurement artifacts.

concepts/enterprise-knowledge-management.title: Enterprise Knowledge Management
concepts/enterprise-knowledge-management.summary: The organizational discipline of capturing, organizing, sharing, and governing knowledge at scale. The KM software market is $13.70B (2025), growing to $37.64B by 2031 (18.34% CAGR). AI is transforming every layer: ingestion (automated transcription), organization (semantic layers), retrieval (conversational search), and governance (validation pipelines).

concepts/enterprise-search.title: Enterprise Search
concepts/enterprise-search.summary: AI-powered unified search across all enterprise applications and data sources. Market: $6.83B (2025), projected $11.15B by 2030. Core architecture: Enterprise Graph linking people/data/processes, 100+ SaaS integrations, permission-aware RAG, conversational AI interfaces. Evolving from search into agentic workflow automation.

concepts/entity-linking.title: Entity Linking and Resolution
concepts/entity-linking.summary: Mapping textual entity mentions to canonical KB entries — resolving ambiguity ('Apple' the company vs. fruit) and merging synonyms ('GPT-4o' / 'gpt4o') via LLM-based clustering and ontology grounding.

concepts/evaluation-bias.title: Evaluation Bias in LLM-as-a-Judge
concepts/evaluation-bias.summary: Systematic biases in LLM-based evaluation: position bias (2.5%-82.5% win-rate swing), verbosity bias (>90% preference for longer responses), and self-enhancement bias (87.76% self-preference), with quantified mitigation strategies.

concepts/evaluation-workflow.title: Evaluation Workflow
concepts/evaluation-workflow.summary: A phased approach to LLM evaluation: define success criteria, build evaluation datasets, run automated experiments, stress-test and red-team, deploy production monitoring, and continuously iterate.

concepts/evergreen-notes.title: Evergreen Notes
concepts/evergreen-notes.summary: Andy Matuschak's framework for durable, evolving notes that accumulate insight over time — five principles (atomic, concept-oriented, densely linked, associative ontologies, written for self) that transform note-taking into a thinking practice.

concepts/expert-systems.title: Expert Systems
concepts/expert-systems.summary: Rule-based AI systems (1965-1990s) that encoded domain expertise as if-then rules in a knowledge base paired with an inference engine — the first commercially successful AI, ultimately killed by the knowledge acquisition bottleneck.

concepts/explainable-ai-ux.title: Explainable AI UX
concepts/explainable-ai-ux.summary: Four practical design patterns for making AI explainable in products: Because Statement, What-If Interactive, Highlight Reel, Push-and-Pull Visual — plus the warning that explanation can backfire if it creates excessive cognitive load.

concepts/extended-thinking.title: Extended Thinking
concepts/extended-thinking.summary: Claude's step-by-step reasoning capability that allocates additional compute at inference time: evolved from manual budget_tokens (Claude 4) to adaptive thinking (Claude 4.6) where the model dynamically decides reasoning depth.

concepts/faithfulness-and-groundedness.title: Faithfulness and Groundedness
concepts/faithfulness-and-groundedness.summary: Faithfulness measures whether LLM outputs are factually consistent with provided context; groundedness measures the degree to which answers are supported by retrieved documents — the positive framing of 'not hallucinating.'

concepts/federated-knowledge.title: Federated Knowledge
concepts/federated-knowledge.summary: Distributed knowledge architectures where independent nodes maintain their own knowledge while sharing across a network — from Cunningham's Federated Wiki ('chorus of voices') to Wikibase's federated knowledge graphs with underlays, overlays, and interlace.

concepts/few-shot-prompting.title: Few-Shot Prompting
concepts/few-shot-prompting.summary: In-context learning via demonstration examples within prompts — the highest-ROI prompt engineering technique, where format and distribution matter more than label accuracy.

concepts/file-over-app.title: File Over App
concepts/file-over-app.summary: Steph Ango's philosophy that files in open formats outlast any application — the foundational design principle behind Obsidian's local-first, plain-text architecture.

concepts/fine-tuning.title: Fine-Tuning LLMs
concepts/fine-tuning.summary: Adapting pretrained LLMs to domain-specific tasks by training on curated datasets — from full fine-tuning to parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/QLoRA) to hybrid approaches (RAFT).

concepts/flash-attention.title: FlashAttention
concepts/flash-attention.summary: IO-aware attention algorithm using tiling to avoid materializing the N x N attention matrix in GPU HBM — reducing memory from O(N^2) to O(N) and achieving 2-4x speedup. FlashAttention-3 reaches 75% H100 utilization.

concepts/flow-matching.title: Flow Matching
concepts/flow-matching.summary: Generative framework learning velocity fields that transport noise distributions to data distributions along straight-line ODE paths -- simpler, faster, and more flexible than traditional diffusion denoising, now the standard training objective for FLUX, SD3, and other leading models.

concepts/foundation-models-for-robotics.title: Foundation Models for Robotics
concepts/foundation-models-for-robotics.summary: The application of the foundation model paradigm (large-scale pre-training → task-specific fine-tuning) to robotics — enabling generalist robot policies that transfer across tasks, environments, and robot morphologies; key models include RT-2, π0, GR00T-N1, and OpenVLA.

concepts/function-calling.title: Function Calling
concepts/function-calling.summary: The mechanism by which LLMs invoke external APIs — each provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) implements differently. Simple and fast for prototyping but creates vendor lock-in and M×N integration problems at scale.

concepts/graphrag.title: GraphRAG
concepts/graphrag.summary: Microsoft's graph-based RAG variant that constructs knowledge graphs from text, clusters them into communities with pre-generated summaries, enabling holistic and aggregate queries that baseline RAG cannot answer.

concepts/grounding-and-faithfulness.title: Grounding and Faithfulness
concepts/grounding-and-faithfulness.summary: Techniques for anchoring LLM outputs to source material and external knowledge — RAG, knowledge graph integration, span-level attribution, and faithfulness checking — as the primary defense against hallucination.

concepts/grouped-query-attention.title: Grouped-Query Attention (GQA)
concepts/grouped-query-attention.summary: Attention variant sharing KV heads across groups of query heads — interpolating between full multi-head attention (MHA) and multi-query attention (MQA) to reduce KV cache memory with minimal quality loss.

concepts/hallucination-contamination.title: Hallucination Contamination
concepts/hallucination-contamination.summary: The risk that LLM-generated errors written into a wiki propagate into future queries and fine-tuning, corrupting the knowledge base over time.

concepts/hallucination-detection.title: Hallucination Detection
concepts/hallucination-detection.summary: Methods for detecting LLM hallucinations: white-box (token probability, semantic entropy), black-box (perturbation, SLM/LLM-as-judge), and rubric-based approaches achieving 0.81-0.86 F1 on production benchmarks.

concepts/hierarchical-memory.title: Hierarchical Memory
concepts/hierarchical-memory.summary: Multi-tier memory for LLM agents: working memory (in-context), episodic memory (session summaries), semantic memory (entity abstractions), and archival memory (external DB) — inspired by both OS design and cognitive science.

concepts/hierarchical-retrieval.title: Hierarchical Retrieval
concepts/hierarchical-retrieval.summary: Retrieval across multiple levels of abstraction — from raw chunks to summaries to themes — addressing the limitation that standard RAG only fetches short contiguous text fragments.

concepts/hnsw.title: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World)
concepts/hnsw.summary: The dominant graph-based ANN algorithm for vector search: a multi-layer proximity graph enabling O(log n) nearest-neighbor queries with 80-99% recall at 1-50ms latency, used by nearly all major vector databases.

concepts/html-to-markdown-conversion.title: HTML to Markdown Conversion
