concepts/html-to-markdown-conversion.summary: Converting extracted HTML content to clean markdown — from rule-based libraries (Turndown, html2text, Pandoc) to neural models (Reader-LM v2, ROUGE-L 0.86) — the format bridge between web content and LLM-consumable knowledge.

concepts/human-ai-collaboration-design.title: Human-AI Collaboration Design
concepts/human-ai-collaboration-design.summary: The product design discipline for AI collaboration interfaces — five principles (Transparency, Personalization, Control, Resilience, Trust) with fluid control between human and AI; grounded in the finding that more engagement mechanisms can paradoxically harm performance.

concepts/human-ai-collaboration.title: Human-AI Collaboration
concepts/human-ai-collaboration.summary: How humans and AI systems work together in knowledge creation — ranging from AI as research assistant to AI as full participant — with the sobering finding that human-only teams currently outperform human-AI teams in information sharing.

concepts/human-in-the-loop.title: Human-in-the-Loop
concepts/human-in-the-loop.summary: Design patterns embedding human judgment into AI workflows — synchronous approval, asynchronous audit, confidence-based escalation — and their evolution toward AI-governing-AI as agentic systems outpace human review capacity.

concepts/humanoid-robots.title: Humanoid Robots
concepts/humanoid-robots.summary: Human-shaped robots designed to navigate existing infrastructure without modification; market projected at $30-50B by 2035 (UBS); key players include Tesla Optimus ($20-30K target), Figure AI ($39B valuation), Boston Dynamics Atlas, 1X NEO, and Unitree; form factor wins on infrastructure compatibility.

concepts/hybrid-retrieval.title: Hybrid Retrieval
concepts/hybrid-retrieval.summary: Combining knowledge graphs and vector databases for AI retrieval: graphs provide entity relationships, permissions, and multi-hop reasoning while vectors enable semantic search over unstructured content.

concepts/hybrid-search.title: Hybrid Search
concepts/hybrid-search.summary: Combining BM25/SPLADE keyword search with dense vector search in parallel, merging via RRF or convex combination — yielding +26-31% NDCG improvement on BEIR benchmarks over single-method retrieval.

concepts/hypertext.title: Hypertext
concepts/hypertext.summary: Nonsequential writing with reader-chosen paths through linked documents — coined by Ted Nelson in 1965, rooted in Bush's Memex (1945), partially realized by the World Wide Web, and foundational to wiki-based knowledge systems.

concepts/image-captioning.title: Image Captioning
concepts/image-captioning.summary: Automatically generating natural language descriptions of images; evolved from CNN+LSTM through attention/transformers to multimodal LLMs; critical for making visual content searchable in knowledge bases.

concepts/image-generation.title: Image Generation
concepts/image-generation.summary: The field of AI-driven image synthesis from text, image, or other inputs -- dominated in 2026 by diffusion-based models (FLUX, SD3, Midjourney) using DiT architectures and flow matching, with autoregressive approaches (LlamaGen, NextStep-1) emerging as serious competitors.

concepts/image-understanding.title: Image Understanding
concepts/image-understanding.summary: The AI capability of interpreting, analyzing, and reasoning about visual content — from object recognition to chart analysis to document comprehension; now a core feature of leading LLMs.

concepts/incremental-etl.title: Incremental ETL and Change Data Capture
concepts/incremental-etl.summary: Processing only new or changed data rather than full rebuilds: watermark-based tracking, CDC from database logs, append-only/upsert/SCD2 patterns, and LlamaIndex's docstore deduplication — reducing compute by 10-100x.

concepts/inference-scaling-laws.title: Inference Scaling Laws
concepts/inference-scaling-laws.summary: Formal mathematical relationships governing how LLM performance scales with inference-time compute -- the deployment-side counterpart to Chinchilla training scaling laws, establishing inference compute as an independently optimizable axis.

concepts/infinite-context.title: Infinite Context
concepts/infinite-context.summary: Architectural approaches to unbounded sequence processing: StreamingLLM (attention sinks), Infini-attention (compressive memory), Ring Attention (multi-device), InfLLM (external lookup) — each with different tradeoffs in retrieval, training, and hardware.

concepts/information-architecture.title: Information Architecture
concepts/information-architecture.summary: The structural design of shared information environments -- organization, labeling, search, and navigation systems. IA operates across all information management levels (not just presentation), determining how taxonomies and ontologies are applied to user experience. Critical for enterprise knowledge scaling: determines what knowledge is visible, findable, and navigable.

concepts/information-extraction.title: Information Extraction with LLMs
concepts/information-extraction.summary: The discipline of automatically extracting structured knowledge (entities, relations, claims, facts) from unstructured text using LLMs — the foundational capability enabling wiki compilation pipelines.

concepts/instruction-tuning.title: Instruction Tuning
concepts/instruction-tuning.summary: Fine-tuning a pretrained LLM on instruction-response pairs to make it follow human instructions — the bridge between raw pretraining and RLHF alignment, with dataset choice critically affecting which skills emerge.

concepts/intelligence-explosion.title: Intelligence Explosion
concepts/intelligence-explosion.summary: The hypothesis that AGI could automate AI research itself, compressing decades of progress into months — producing superintelligence rapidly and creating the most consequential event in human history.

concepts/ipo.title: Identity Preference Optimization (IPO)
concepts/ipo.summary: A DPO variant that replaces logit functions with identity functions and adds regularization to prevent overfitting -- addressing DPO's tendency to overfit preference data, especially with deterministic preferences.

concepts/jepa.title: JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture)
concepts/jepa.summary: Yann LeCun's Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture: predicts representations rather than pixels using energy-based models, avoiding both generative intractability and contrastive dimensionality curse — the foundation for I-JEPA, V-JEPA, V-JEPA 2, H-JEPA, and LeWorldModel.

concepts/keyword-search.title: Keyword Search
concepts/keyword-search.summary: Lexical search using inverted indexes and BM25 ranking: fast, deterministic, and precise for exact terms, but blind to synonyms and conceptual relationships.

concepts/knowledge-base-product-gap.title: Knowledge Base Product Gap
concepts/knowledge-base-product-gap.summary: Karpathy's own acknowledgment that the current LLM-KB is 'a hacky collection of scripts' — and the product opportunity to build polished tooling that makes AI-maintained wikis accessible to non-technical users.

concepts/knowledge-commons.title: Knowledge Commons
concepts/knowledge-commons.summary: Collectively owned and managed knowledge resources (Wikipedia, open-source, Creative Commons) — non-subtractible unlike natural commons — now facing an existential challenge as AI extracts value from commons data while potentially degrading the ecosystems that produce it.

concepts/knowledge-distillation.title: Knowledge Distillation
concepts/knowledge-distillation.summary: Transferring capabilities from large teacher models to small student models via logit matching, feature mimicry, or rationale extraction — enabling deployment-friendly models at a fraction of the cost.

concepts/knowledge-editing.title: Knowledge Editing
concepts/knowledge-editing.summary: Targeted modification of specific factual associations in model weights without full retraining — via methods like ROME (single facts) and MEMIT (thousands of facts) — with inherent scalability limits.

concepts/knowledge-extraction.title: Knowledge Extraction
concepts/knowledge-extraction.summary: LLM-driven extraction of entities, relations, and facts from unstructured text — the core pipeline stage of knowledge graph construction, now achieving near-expert accuracy via few-shot prompting.

concepts/knowledge-fusion.title: Knowledge Fusion
concepts/knowledge-fusion.summary: The process of merging, deduplicating, and reconciling extracted knowledge from multiple sources into a unified knowledge graph — addressing entity alignment, schema reconciliation, and conflict resolution.

concepts/knowledge-governance.title: Knowledge Governance
concepts/knowledge-governance.summary: The policies, processes, roles, and standards governing how knowledge is created, validated, maintained, and retired in an organization. Governance maturity is a prerequisite (not afterthought) to scaling knowledge systems. Includes access control (NIST SP 800-53), validation pipelines, content ownership, and emerging AI Governance departments.

concepts/knowledge-graph-completion.title: Knowledge Graph Completion
concepts/knowledge-graph-completion.summary: Predicting missing facts in incomplete knowledge graphs via link prediction, relation prediction, and triple classification — now dramatically improved by LLM-based approaches outperforming traditional embedding methods.

concepts/knowledge-graph-construction.title: Knowledge Graph Construction
concepts/knowledge-graph-construction.summary: The end-to-end process of building knowledge graphs from unstructured data, now transformed by LLMs from rule-based pipelines to generative frameworks achieving near-human-expert quality.

concepts/knowledge-graph-embeddings.title: Knowledge Graph Embeddings
concepts/knowledge-graph-embeddings.summary: Machine learning methods that map knowledge graph entities and relations to continuous vector spaces for link prediction, with three model families (translational, tensor decomposition, deep learning) increasingly complemented by LLM approaches.

concepts/knowledge-graph.title: Knowledge Graph
concepts/knowledge-graph.summary: Formal representation of knowledge as nodes (entities) and edges (relationships), with three distinct modern approaches: KARMA (automated multi-agent enrichment), Graphiti (temporal context graphs), and Gallagher's Knowledge Graph Kit (personal SQLite graph).

concepts/knowledge-management-challenges.title: Knowledge Management Challenges
concepts/knowledge-management-challenges.summary: Systematic inventory of enterprise KM obstacles: lack of executive/employee buy-in, outdated tools, unstructured processes, knowledge silos, workflow integration difficulties, scaling challenges, ROI measurement difficulty. Well-implemented KM generates 200-400% ROI in year one, but fewer than 40% of organizations can articulate clear ROI metrics.

concepts/knowledge-representation.title: Knowledge Representation
concepts/knowledge-representation.summary: The AI discipline of encoding information so machines can reason over it — spanning 65+ years from logic and frames through expert systems, ontologies, and knowledge graphs to modern LLM-based implicit representations.

concepts/knowledge-silos.title: Knowledge Silos
concepts/knowledge-silos.summary: Critical knowledge trapped within specific teams, departments, or systems. 79% of employees confirm siloed information; ~3.7 hours/day lost (2h redundant tasks + 1.7h repeated questions). Revenue impact up to 30%. Primary solutions: unified enterprise search, cultural change, and cross-team knowledge governance.

concepts/knowledge-storage-in-transforme.title: Knowledge Storage in Transformers
concepts/knowledge-storage-in-transforme.summary: How transformer LLMs store and retrieve factual knowledge: MLP layers act as key-value memories storing facts in their weight matrices, while attention heads serve as routing mechanisms — together forming 'knowledge circuits' that enable surgical knowledge editing.

concepts/knowledge-system-scaling.title: Knowledge System Scaling
concepts/knowledge-system-scaling.summary: The process of expanding knowledge infrastructure to serve thousands of concurrent users across heterogeneous data environments while maintaining consistency. Three complexity dimensions (Volume, Velocity, Variety), four-phase architecture (partition/federation, indexing, validation, governance), and critical decision boundaries (CAP theorem, governance maturity threshold).

concepts/kto.title: Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO)
concepts/kto.summary: A prospect-theory-based alignment method that uses binary desirable/undesirable signals instead of pairwise preferences, outperforming DPO on noisy real-world data and matching SFT+DPO combined on Llama models.

concepts/kv-cache.title: KV Cache
concepts/kv-cache.summary: The key-value cache stores pre-computed attention vectors to avoid recalculation during autoregressive decoding; its management (PagedAttention, GQA, SWA) is the central bottleneck of LLM inference.

concepts/late-interaction-retrieval.title: Late Interaction Retrieval
concepts/late-interaction-retrieval.summary: A retrieval paradigm between bi-encoders and cross-encoders: independently encode queries and documents into per-token embeddings, then compute fine-grained MaxSim scoring at query time — balancing accuracy and speed.

concepts/latent-world-models.title: Latent World Models
concepts/latent-world-models.summary: World models that compress observations into compact latent representations and predict dynamics there — from Ha & Schmidhuber's 32-dim VAE to DreamerV3's RSSM to V-JEPA 2's 1.2B-param ViT — enabling sample-efficient planning through imagination.

concepts/learning-in-public.title: Learning in Public
concepts/learning-in-public.summary: The practice of sharing your learning journey as it happens — publishing half-finished thoughts with epistemic status markers, embracing imperfection, and reducing friction between learning and publishing — core to the digital garden philosophy.

concepts/learning-rate-schedules.title: Learning Rate Schedules
concepts/learning-rate-schedules.summary: How the learning rate varies during LLM training: warmup phase (linear ramp, 1-10% of steps), followed by cosine decay or the newer Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) schedule. Critical for both stability and final model quality.

concepts/linear-attention.title: Linear Attention
concepts/linear-attention.summary: Approximating softmax attention by decomposing it via kernel functions to avoid materializing the N x N attention matrix — reducing complexity from O(N^2 * d) to O(N * d^2), but with significant expressiveness tradeoffs that limit practical adoption.

concepts/linting-and-health-checks.title: Linting and Health Checks
concepts/linting-and-health-checks.summary: LLM-driven health checks over the compiled wiki to find inconsistencies, fill data gaps, detect broken links, identify orphan articles, and suggest new content.

concepts/llm-agent-architecture.title: LLM Agent Architecture
concepts/llm-agent-architecture.summary: The four-component architecture of LLM agents (brain, memory, planning, tools) and the design pattern spectrum from simple LLM+prompt to multi-agent systems.

concepts/llm-api-pricing.title: LLM API Pricing
concepts/llm-api-pricing.summary: LLM API pricing landscape in 2026: prices dropped ~80% since early 2025; output tokens cost 3-5x more than input; premium-to-lightweight gap is 60-300x; batch APIs offer 50% discounts.

concepts/llm-applications-beyond-code.title: LLM Applications Beyond Code
concepts/llm-applications-beyond-code.summary: The expanding frontier of LLM applications beyond code generation — writing, research, education, science, healthcare, law, creative work — representing Karpathy's 'knowledge manipulation' shift across all professional domains.

concepts/llm-as-judge.title: LLM-as-a-Judge
concepts/llm-as-judge.summary: Using powerful LLMs (GPT-4, Claude) to evaluate outputs from other LLMs; achieves 80-85% human agreement but exhibits position, verbosity, and self-enhancement biases requiring active mitigation.

concepts/llm-benchmarks.title: LLM Benchmarks
concepts/llm-benchmarks.summary: Standardized evaluation datasets for comparing LLM capabilities: MMLU (knowledge), HELM (holistic), TruthfulQA (factuality), HumanEval (code), MT-Bench (conversation), Chatbot Arena (crowdsourced), with 15 benchmarks in active use by 2026.

concepts/llm-cost-optimization.title: LLM Cost Optimization
concepts/llm-cost-optimization.summary: Strategies for reducing LLM API and infrastructure costs by 50-85%: prompt optimization, caching (prompt + semantic), model routing, batching, output constraints, and self-hosting at scale.

concepts/llm-creative-applications.title: LLM Creative Applications
concepts/llm-creative-applications.summary: LLMs as creative tools — story writing (Gemini 3 Pro #1 on LM Arena), ideation (brainstorming adoption +12%), interactive storytelling, and creative direction — with the paradox that AI improves individual output while homogenizing collective creativity.

concepts/llm-data-analysis.title: LLM Data Analysis
concepts/llm-data-analysis.summary: LLMs automate data analysis via natural language to code translation, but face a critical executability-correctness gap: code that runs is not always code that works (88% correct at simple tasks, 0% at complex). Self-correction loops improve performance by up to 52.5%.

concepts/llm-education-tutoring.title: LLM Education and Tutoring
concepts/llm-education-tutoring.summary: LLM-powered tutoring systems achieve significant learning gains (Physics-STAR: 100% score increase, Tutorly: +15pp, AgentTutor: +24-30pp) using IRT models, Bayesian mastery tracking, and multi-agent architectures — spanning STEM, soft skills, and teacher development.

concepts/llm-evaluation-metrics.title: LLM Evaluation Metrics
concepts/llm-evaluation-metrics.summary: Taxonomy of metrics for evaluating LLM output quality: statistical scorers (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), LLM-as-a-Judge methods (G-Eval, QAG), and domain-specific metrics for RAG, agents, safety, and factuality.

concepts/llm-hallucination.title: LLM Hallucination
concepts/llm-hallucination.summary: When LLMs generate fluent but factually incorrect or unsupported text — classified by type (factuality vs. faithfulness, intrinsic vs. extrinsic), caused across the full development lifecycle, and addressed through detection and mitigation taxonomies.

concepts/llm-healthcare-applications.title: LLM Healthcare Applications
concepts/llm-healthcare-applications.summary: Seven healthcare LLM domains — clinical decision support (GPT-4: 93.1% USMLE), education, patient care, literature, drug discovery, radiology, documentation — with specialized models (Med-PaLM, GatorTron, LLaVA-Med) and critical hallucination/bias challenges.

concepts/llm-inference-optimization.title: LLM Inference Optimization
concepts/llm-inference-optimization.summary: The umbrella discipline of reducing latency, cost, and resource consumption of LLM inference through KV cache management, batching, quantization, speculative decoding, and serving infrastructure.

concepts/llm-knowledge-base.title: LLM Knowledge Base
concepts/llm-knowledge-base.summary: A personal knowledge base where an LLM authors and maintains all wiki content from raw ingested sources, with humans interacting only via natural language.

concepts/llm-legal-applications.title: LLM Legal Applications
concepts/llm-legal-applications.summary: LLM adoption in legal surged from 19% to 79% in one year (Clio 2024) — three primary use cases (document review, drafting, research) with tools like Everlaw, Luminance, Casetext — transforming lawyers from drafters to curators.

concepts/llm-os.title: LLM OS
concepts/llm-os.summary: Karpathy's metaphor reframing LLMs not as chatbots but as the kernel of a new operating system: CPU (reasoning), RAM (context window), filesystem (RAG), with natural language as the programming interface.

concepts/llm-pretraining.title: LLM Pretraining
concepts/llm-pretraining.summary: The foundational training phase where LLMs learn language by predicting the next token across trillions of tokens of text — the most compute-intensive and expensive stage of the LLM pipeline, costing $5M-$200M for frontier models.

concepts/llm-product-development.title: LLM Product Development
concepts/llm-product-development.summary: Building LLM-powered products requires fundamentally different practices: thin-slice MVPs, provisional approvals over lengthy validation, Master LLM routing, customer-driven training, and first iterations focused on data collection rather than polish.

concepts/llm-qa-over-documents.title: LLM Q&A Over Documents
concepts/llm-qa-over-documents.summary: Using an LLM agent to answer complex questions over a compiled wiki by reading index files and summaries to navigate to relevant full articles, without needing a vector database.

concepts/llm-reasoning-limitations.title: LLM Reasoning Limitations
concepts/llm-reasoning-limitations.summary: Systematic catalogue of LLM reasoning failures: fragility to irrelevant information (up to 65% drops), sensitivity to numerical variations, compositional reasoning breakdowns, and architectural root causes in next-token prediction and attention mechanisms.

concepts/llm-reasoning.title: LLM Reasoning
concepts/llm-reasoning.summary: The ability of large language models to perform multi-step inference, logical deduction, and problem-solving -- achieved through prompting techniques (CoT, ToT), training methods (RL), and inference-time scaling, though the nature and limits of this reasoning remain deeply debated.

concepts/llm-serving-frameworks.title: LLM Serving Frameworks
concepts/llm-serving-frameworks.summary: Production software for serving LLM inference: vLLM (production default, broadest hardware), SGLang (throughput leader, multi-turn specialist), Triton (enterprise NVIDIA), with TGI in maintenance mode since Dec 2025.

concepts/llm-summarization.title: LLM Summarization Techniques
concepts/llm-summarization.summary: Extractive vs. abstractive summarization with LLMs — in practice LLMs are more extractive than expected; hybrid extract-then-abstract approaches produce the most reliable wiki summaries.

concepts/llm-training-costs.title: LLM Training Costs
concepts/llm-training-costs.summary: Frontier LLM training costs $5M-$200M, dominated by GPU compute (70-80%). GPT-4 ~$100-150M, Gemini Ultra ~$191M, Llama 3.1 405B ~$170M. DeepSeek V3's $5.6M challenged the assumption that frontier requires $100M+.

concepts/llms-as-knowledge-bases.title: LLMs as Knowledge Bases
concepts/llms-as-knowledge-bases.summary: The question of whether LLMs' implicit parametric knowledge can replace traditional KBs — evaluated at only ~32% consistent correctness, motivating hybrid approaches where explicit structured knowledge complements LLM reasoning.

concepts/local-knowledge-base.title: Local Knowledge Base
concepts/local-knowledge-base.summary: Running an LLM-powered knowledge base entirely on local hardware — using Ollama + open-source models + ChromaDB/FAISS — for privacy, offline operation, and zero API costs.

concepts/local-llm-inference.title: Local LLM Inference
concepts/local-llm-inference.summary: Running LLM inference on local hardware without cloud APIs, using tools like Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, and MLX — enabling privacy, offline operation, and zero per-token cost.

concepts/long-context-models.title: Long-Context Models
concepts/long-context-models.summary: Models designed for extended context: Gemini (1-2M), Claude (200K-1M), Llama 4 Scout (10M), Magic LTM-2-Mini (100M) — each with distinct architecture-efficiency tradeoffs.

concepts/loss-spikes.title: Loss Spikes
concepts/loss-spikes.summary: Sudden catastrophic increases in training loss caused by gradient norm explosions (up to 1000x normal), which can degrade or ruin expensive LLM pretraining runs. Preventable through proper initialization, embedding normalization, and gradient clipping.

concepts/lost-in-the-middle.title: Lost in the Middle
concepts/lost-in-the-middle.summary: LLMs exhibit a U-shaped performance curve — best at beginning/end of context, >30% degradation in the middle — caused by attention accumulation patterns in transformers.

concepts/mamba.title: Mamba (Selective State Space Model)
concepts/mamba.summary: The leading SSM architecture making state transitions input-dependent (selective), with hardware-aware kernel fusion and parallel scan — achieving transformer-competitive performance with linear-time inference.

concepts/markdown-as-universal-interface.title: Markdown as Universal Interface
concepts/markdown-as-universal-interface.summary: Markdown is simultaneously human-readable, LLM-friendly (25-75% fewer tokens than HTML), version-controllable, tool-agnostic, institutionally recommended for preservation, and backed by a massive ecosystem — making it the optimal substrate for AI-era knowledge management.

concepts/markdown-ecosystem.title: Markdown Ecosystem
concepts/markdown-ecosystem.summary: The constellation of tools, converters, frameworks, and standards that make markdown a practical universal format: Pandoc, MDX, Marp, MarkdownDB, MarkItDown, SSGs, and more.

concepts/markdown-for-ai-agents.title: Markdown for AI Agents
concepts/markdown-for-ai-agents.summary: LLMs natively comprehend markdown due to training data representation and AST-based tokenization — making it 25-75% more token-efficient than HTML and yielding 89% vs 62% RAG retrieval accuracy.

concepts/mathematical-reasoning-llm.title: Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs
concepts/mathematical-reasoning-llm.summary: The capacity of LLMs to solve mathematical problems -- from grade school (GSM8K) to competition level (AIME) -- with reasoning models achieving 96.7% on AIME, yet fundamental fragility persists: performance drops up to 65% with irrelevant information.

concepts/matryoshka-representation-learn.title: Matryoshka Representation Learning
concepts/matryoshka-representation-learn.summary: Training technique that produces embeddings usable at any dimension by frontloading important information in earlier dimensions — preserving 98.37% of performance at just 8.3% of original size, now standard in state-of-the-art models.

concepts/mcp-code-execution-pattern.title: MCP Code Execution Pattern
concepts/mcp-code-execution-pattern.summary: Anthropic's optimization pattern: agents write code to interact with MCP tools instead of loading all definitions into context — achieving 98.7% token savings, PII filtering, and persistent state management.

concepts/mcp-ecosystem.title: MCP Server Ecosystem
concepts/mcp-ecosystem.summary: The rapidly growing MCP server ecosystem: 12K+ servers across public registries (PulseMCP, mcp.so, MCPMarket), 97M monthly SDK downloads, categories spanning databases to design tools, shift from local stdio to remote HTTP transport.

concepts/mcp-security.title: MCP Security
concepts/mcp-security.summary: Security vulnerabilities and mitigations for MCP: prompt injection through tool descriptions, tool spoofing/lookalike attacks, OAuth token vulnerabilities, toxic agent data exfiltration, and per-server isolation as defense-in-depth.

concepts/mdx.title: MDX (Markdown + JSX)
concepts/mdx.summary: MDX extends markdown with JSX components — enabling interactive, component-based content within markdown documents while compiling to JavaScript at build time with zero runtime.

concepts/memex-and-tools-for-thought.title: Memex and Tools for Thought
concepts/memex-and-tools-for-thought.summary: The lineage from Vannevar Bush's 1945 memex concept through Engelbart's mouse/hypertext, Nelson's hypertext/Xanadu, and Berners-Lee's Web to modern PKM tools — tracing 80 years of attempts to build systems that augment human knowledge management through associative linking.

concepts/memex.title: Memex
concepts/memex.summary: Vannevar Bush's 1945 hypothetical device for storing and associatively linking personal knowledge — the conceptual ancestor of hypertext, the web, and modern personal knowledge management systems.

concepts/memory-augmented-neural-network.title: Memory-Augmented Neural Networks
concepts/memory-augmented-neural-network.summary: Neural architectures coupling a controller network with explicit external memory via differentiable read/write operations — from Neural Turing Machines (2014) and DNCs (2016) to modern retrieval-augmented transformers like RETRO, representing the evolution of how neural networks access stored knowledge.

concepts/meta-prompting.title: Meta-Prompting
concepts/meta-prompting.summary: The practice of using LLMs to generate, evaluate, and optimize prompts for LLMs — 'prompts that write other prompts' — with frameworks like DSPy (46%→64% accuracy) and TextGrad (Nature 2025) formalizing the approach.

concepts/mixed-precision-training.title: Mixed-Precision Training
concepts/mixed-precision-training.summary: Using lower-precision formats (FP16, BFloat16) during training to reduce memory and increase throughput. BFloat16 is now industry standard — its 8 exponent bits match FP32's dynamic range, virtually eliminating the overflow issues that plague FP16.

concepts/mixture-of-experts.title: Mixture of Experts (MoE)
concepts/mixture-of-experts.summary: Sparse transformer architecture replacing dense FFN layers with multiple expert networks + learned router — scaling model capacity without proportional inference cost. By 2025, the default for all frontier LLMs.

concepts/model-based-filtering.title: Model-Based Filtering
concepts/model-based-filtering.summary: Using trained classifiers (fastText, LLM-based scorers) to filter web data for LLM pretraining — the single most impactful curation technique, outperforming heuristics, perplexity filtering, and human judgment.

concepts/model-collapse.title: Model Collapse
concepts/model-collapse.summary: Degenerative feedback loop where models trained on synthetic data from models trained on synthetic data progressively lose capability — mitigated by human-data anchoring and lineage tracking.

concepts/model-context-protocol.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
concepts/model-context-protocol.summary: Open standard (JSON-RPC 2.0) for connecting AI models to external tools and data — the 'USB-C for AI'. Launched by Anthropic Nov 2024, adopted by OpenAI/Google 2025, donated to Linux Foundation Dec 2025. 97M monthly SDK downloads, 12K+ servers.

concepts/model-routing.title: Model Routing
concepts/model-routing.summary: Intelligent dispatching of LLM queries to appropriately-sized models based on complexity, achieving 40-85% cost reduction while maintaining 95%+ quality through predictive routing, cascading, or benchmark-trained classifiers.

concepts/multi-agent-systems.title: Multi-Agent Systems
concepts/multi-agent-systems.summary: Networks of specialized LLM agents collaborating through cooperation, competition, or coopetition — from KARMA's 9-agent KG pipeline to general-purpose orchestrator-worker architectures.

concepts/multi-head-attention.title: Multi-Head Attention
concepts/multi-head-attention.summary: Running multiple parallel self-attention heads with independent Q/K/V projections, then concatenating results — enabling the model to capture diverse relationship types simultaneously.

concepts/multi-stage-pretraining.title: Multi-Stage Pretraining
concepts/multi-stage-pretraining.summary: The universal 2024 practice of training LLMs in sequential phases with different data mixes: broad web data first, then high-quality math/code, then context extension. Used by Llama 3.1, Apple AFM, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.

concepts/multilingual-tokenization.title: Multilingual Tokenization
concepts/multilingual-tokenization.summary: The structural barrier preventing equitable LLM performance across languages — tokenizers trained on English-heavy corpora create 2-15x token overhead for low-resource languages, wasting context, compute, and model capacity.

concepts/multilingual-training-data.title: Multilingual Training Data
concepts/multilingual-training-data.summary: The challenge of building LLM training datasets that serve non-English languages equitably — complicated by data scarcity, quality degradation in low-resource languages, and the English dominance of web data.

concepts/multimodal-ai.title: Multimodal AI
concepts/multimodal-ai.summary: AI systems that process and reason across multiple data modalities (text, images, audio, video); by 2026 multimodal capability has become baseline rather than differentiator.

concepts/multimodal-embeddings.title: Multimodal Embeddings
concepts/multimodal-embeddings.summary: Embedding models that map images and text into a shared vector space via contrastive learning, enabling cross-modal similarity search — foundational for multimodal RAG and image retrieval.

concepts/multimodal-rag.title: Multimodal RAG
concepts/multimodal-rag.summary: Extending RAG to retrieve and reason over images alongside text; three architectures (unified embeddings, text grounding, separate stores with re-ranking) with tradeoffs between simplicity and fidelity.

concepts/multimodal-transformers.title: Multimodal Transformers
concepts/multimodal-transformers.summary: Transformer architectures processing multiple modalities (text, image, video, audio, actions) — evolving from encoder-bridge-decoder to native multimodal fusion, with MoE decoders dominating by 2025.

concepts/named-entity-recognition.title: Named Entity Recognition (NER) with LLMs
concepts/named-entity-recognition.summary: Identifying and classifying named entities (people, organizations, locations, etc.) in text — LLMs bridge the sequence-labeling-to-generation gap via task reformulation and self-verification.

concepts/natural-language-programming.title: Natural Language Programming
concepts/natural-language-programming.summary: The practice of specifying software behavior in natural language rather than formal programming languages -- from Karpathy's 'English is the hottest programming language' to production-grade spec-driven development with LLM agents.

concepts/needle-in-a-haystack.title: Needle in a Haystack (NIAH)
concepts/needle-in-a-haystack.summary: The standard evaluation for long-context LLMs: embed a specific fact (needle) at varying depths within a large context (haystack) and test if the model can retrieve it.

concepts/networked-thought.title: Networked Thought
concepts/networked-thought.summary: The paradigm of organizing knowledge as interconnected networks rather than hierarchical trees — from Bush's associative trails (1945) through Luhmann's Zettelkasten to modern bidirectional linking tools — based on the insight that meaning emerges from connections between ideas, not from their categorical placement.

concepts/neural-symbolic-integration.title: Neural-Symbolic Integration
concepts/neural-symbolic-integration.summary: The emerging paradigm combining symbolic reasoning (explainable, compositional, precise) with neural networks (learnable, perceptual, scalable) — six architectures catalogued, from language models with symbolic tokens to neural models calling symbolic engines.

concepts/neuroai.title: NeuroAI
concepts/neuroai.summary: The interdisciplinary field at the intersection of neuroscience and AI, arguing that understanding biological intelligence is key to building the next generation of artificial intelligence systems.

concepts/next-token-prediction.title: Next-Token Prediction
concepts/next-token-prediction.summary: The self-supervised training objective for autoregressive LLMs: predict the next token given all preceding tokens, optimized via cross-entropy loss. Requires no labeled data — the next token in the sequence is the label.

concepts/obsidian-ai-integration.title: Obsidian AI Integration
concepts/obsidian-ai-integration.summary: Two paradigms for AI in Obsidian: plugin-based (Copilot, Smart Connections inside the app) and external-agent (Claude Code + MCP operating over the file system) — converging toward governed autonomous vault operations.

concepts/obsidian-as-ide.title: Obsidian as IDE
concepts/obsidian-as-ide.summary: Using Obsidian as a read-only frontend IDE to view LLM-maintained wikis, raw sources, and generated visualizations — with the LLM as the actual author and 2,700+ plugins extending the viewer.

concepts/obsidian-canvas.title: Obsidian Canvas
concepts/obsidian-canvas.summary: Obsidian Canvas provides infinite spatial boards for mapping notes, media, and ideas — enhanced by the Advanced Canvas plugin for flowcharts, presentations, and graph integration.

concepts/obsidian-frontmatter-properties.title: Obsidian Frontmatter and Properties
concepts/obsidian-frontmatter-properties.summary: YAML frontmatter properties in Obsidian provide structured metadata for notes — enabling Dataview queries, AI retrieval, search filtering, and database-like views via the Bases feature.

concepts/obsidian-graph-view.title: Obsidian Graph View
concepts/obsidian-graph-view.summary: Obsidian's graph view visualizes notes as nodes and links as edges — useful for seeing clusters, orphans, and connection patterns, but limited in analytical depth without plugins like InfraNodus.

concepts/obsidian-plugin-ecosystem.title: Obsidian Plugin Ecosystem
concepts/obsidian-plugin-ecosystem.summary: Obsidian's 2,700+ community plugin ecosystem transforms a markdown editor into a programmable knowledge platform — organized into querying, templating, AI, visualization, and automation categories.

concepts/ocr-document-extraction.title: OCR and Document Extraction
concepts/ocr-document-extraction.summary: Modern OCR has evolved from character recognition to document understanding: traditional engines (Tesseract, PaddleOCR) deliver 99%+ on printed text, while LLM-powered models (RolmOCR, Qwen2.5-VL) handle complex layouts, tables, and handwriting.

concepts/ontology-and-taxonomy.title: Ontology and Taxonomy
concepts/ontology-and-taxonomy.summary: Formal knowledge organization systems for enterprise AI. Taxonomy = hierarchical parent-child relationships (single-parent trees). Ontology = relationships across multiple taxonomies (multi-parent inheritance). Together they form the structural scaffolding of semantic layers. Ontology functions as 'master data management for AI' -- changes propagate automatically through associative relationships.

concepts/ontology-engineering.title: Ontology Engineering
concepts/ontology-engineering.summary: The design of formal schemas (ontologies) that define entity types, relation types, and constraints for knowledge graphs — now increasingly automated by LLMs that achieve near-junior-expert quality.

concepts/ontology.title: Ontology (Knowledge Engineering)
concepts/ontology.summary: Formal specification of concepts, relationships, and rules within a knowledge domain — from WordNet and Cyc through OWL/RDF to modern knowledge graphs, with LLM-era 'cheap ontology' as the latest evolution.

concepts/open-source-coding-models.title: Open-Source Coding Models
concepts/open-source-coding-models.summary: Specialized code LLMs — Qwen 2.5 Coder (88.4% HumanEval, Apache 2.0), Codestral (95.3% FIM), DeepSeek Coder (338 languages, 10GB VRAM) — now match or exceed GPT-4 on coding tasks.

concepts/open-source-llms.title: Open-Source LLMs
concepts/open-source-llms.summary: Open-weight LLMs from DeepSeek, Qwen, Meta, Mistral, and others have closed the gap with proprietary models to ~3 months, using MoE architectures and MIT/Apache licensing.

concepts/open-source-vs-closed-ai.title: Open Source vs Closed Source AI
concepts/open-source-vs-closed-ai.summary: The geopolitically charged debate between open-weight AI models (DeepSeek R1, Llama, Mistral) and proprietary systems (GPT, Claude); Chinese open-source usage surged from 1.2% to 30% of global usage in 2025; safety vs. innovation tensions define the regulatory frontier.

concepts/orpo.title: Odds Ratio Preference Optimization (ORPO)
concepts/orpo.summary: A single-step alignment method that combines instruction tuning and preference optimization in one process -- reference-model-free, computationally cheap, and effective with as few as 7K examples.

concepts/paged-attention.title: PagedAttention
concepts/paged-attention.summary: Virtual-memory-inspired KV cache management (vLLM) that allocates non-contiguous memory blocks with mapping tables — reducing waste from 60-80% to 4% and enabling prompt sharing.

concepts/para-method.title: PARA Method
concepts/para-method.summary: Tiago Forte's organizational framework: Projects (short-term, specific goals), Areas (ongoing responsibilities), Resources (future interest), Archive (inactive) — organizing information by actionability rather than topic, designed to mirror how work actually flows.

concepts/parameter-efficient-fine-tuning.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT)
concepts/parameter-efficient-fine-tuning.summary: LoRA and QLoRA enable fine-tuning LLMs by updating only 0.5-5% of parameters via low-rank adapter matrices, reducing VRAM from 60GB to 6GB for a 7B model while retaining 80-95% quality.

concepts/path-to-agi.title: Path to AGI
concepts/path-to-agi.summary: The convergence of scaling, algorithmic efficiency, and unhobbling gains suggests AGI between 2027-2033, with AI leaders predicting the earlier end and researchers the later — but definitions remain deeply contested.

concepts/pdf-parsing-tools.title: PDF Parsing Tools
concepts/pdf-parsing-tools.summary: PDF parsing tool landscape: PyMuPDF4LLM (fastest, 0.12s), Docling (best enterprise, 9/10), Nougat (best scientific), LlamaParse (best tables), Unstructured (best multi-format) — with two paradigms: pipeline vs. end-to-end.

concepts/personal-knowledge-management.title: Personal Knowledge Management (PKM)
concepts/personal-knowledge-management.summary: The practice of capturing, organizing, and retrieving personal knowledge — transformed by LLMs from manual note-taking (Notion/Obsidian) to AI-compiled, queryable wikis with automatic synthesis and gap-filling.

concepts/personalization-in-ai.title: Personalization in AI
concepts/personalization-in-ai.summary: The billion-dollar AI product opportunity: adapting not just what content AI presents but how it presents it — visual learners get diagrams, metaphor-lovers get analogies — requiring consent-based behavioral learning and concierge-style delivery.

concepts/physical-ai.title: Physical AI
concepts/physical-ai.summary: AI systems that perceive, understand, and act in the physical world — autonomous vehicles, robots, and smart spaces — requiring world models that capture physics, object permanence, and spatial reasoning; driven by NVIDIA Cosmos, Physical Intelligence, and the embodied AI ecosystem.

concepts/pipeline-orchestration.title: Pipeline Orchestration
concepts/pipeline-orchestration.summary: Scheduling, monitoring, and managing multi-stage data/ML pipelines: Apache Airflow dominates (35% of enterprises), with Airflow 3.0 adding event-driven scheduling, dynamic task mapping, and real-time reactive orchestration.

concepts/pipeline-parallelism.title: Pipeline Parallelism
concepts/pipeline-parallelism.summary: Inter-layer parallelism that distributes model layers sequentially across GPUs. Lower communication than tensor parallelism but suffers from pipeline bubbles — mitigated by micro-batching and interleaved scheduling.

concepts/plain-text-longevity.title: Plain Text Longevity
concepts/plain-text-longevity.summary: Plain text is the only digital format guaranteed to be readable decades or centuries from now — validated by individual practitioners, Obsidian's CEO, and institutional archivists.

concepts/positional-encoding.title: Positional Encoding
concepts/positional-encoding.summary: Methods for injecting sequence order information into transformers, which are inherently position-agnostic — evolved from sinusoidal (2017) to learned absolute to relative (T5) to rotary (RoPE, now standard).

concepts/post-code-ai-workflow.title: Post-Code AI Workflow
concepts/post-code-ai-workflow.summary: Karpathy's framing of a shift in AI-augmented developer work: from code generation as the primary token use, to knowledge compilation and orchestration — 'manipulating knowledge, not code.'

concepts/ppo-for-llms.title: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) for LLMs
concepts/ppo-for-llms.summary: The dominant RL algorithm for RLHF: a policy-gradient method using trust-region optimization to fine-tune LLMs against reward models while maintaining training stability via clipped objectives and KL penalties.

concepts/predictive-coding.title: Predictive Coding
concepts/predictive-coding.summary: A theory of brain function where the cortex continuously generates top-down predictions and only processes bottom-up prediction errors — the brain as a hierarchical prediction machine that minimizes surprise.

concepts/preference-data.title: Preference Data
concepts/preference-data.summary: Human (or AI) judgments ranking model outputs used to train reward models for RLHF alignment — collected via pairwise comparison, expensive to produce, and critically dependent on on-policy generation and bias mitigation.

concepts/pretraining-data-pipeline.title: Pretraining Data Pipeline
concepts/pretraining-data-pipeline.summary: The multi-stage pipeline for preparing LLM training data: web crawling, URL filtering, text extraction, language filtering, quality filtering, deduplication (MinHash), PII removal, and domain balancing. FineWeb exemplifies this with 15T tokens from 36T after filtering.

concepts/process-reward-model.title: Process Reward Model (PRM)
concepts/process-reward-model.summary: A reward model variant that scores each reasoning step individually rather than only the final output -- providing finer-grained feedback that is harder to hack but requires expensive step-level supervision data.

concepts/process-reward-models.title: Process Reward Models
concepts/process-reward-models.summary: Trained verifier models that evaluate each step in a reasoning chain (not just the final answer), enabling selection of the best reasoning path -- a key building block of test-time compute scaling and reasoning models.

concepts/progressive-disclosure-ai.title: Progressive Disclosure in AI
concepts/progressive-disclosure-ai.summary: The foundational AI design pattern that reveals complexity gradually in 2-3 layers max — solving the engagement-overload paradox where more explanation can backfire; RAG itself is progressive disclosure at the data layer.

concepts/progressive-summarization.title: Progressive Summarization
concepts/progressive-summarization.summary: Tiago Forte's layered distillation technique: bold key passages (Layer 2), highlight the best-of-best (Layer 3), write an executive summary in your own words (Layer 4) — designing notes for your Future Self to scan at any depth.

concepts/prompt-caching.title: Prompt Caching
concepts/prompt-caching.summary: Provider-level optimization caching computed state of static prompt prefixes: Anthropic (90% savings), OpenAI (50%), Google (75%) — making large contexts economically viable.

concepts/prompt-chaining.title: Prompt Chaining
concepts/prompt-chaining.summary: Decomposing complex tasks into sequential LLM calls where each output feeds the next — the foundational pattern for production LLM workflows, enabling transparency, controllability, and debugging.

concepts/prompt-engineering.title: Prompt Engineering
concepts/prompt-engineering.summary: The discipline of designing inputs to LLMs that reliably produce high-quality, accurate, and well-structured outputs — encompassing techniques from simple clarity principles to advanced reasoning scaffolds.

concepts/prompt-injection.title: Prompt Injection
concepts/prompt-injection.summary: Manipulation technique exploiting the fundamental inability to separate LLM instructions from user input — ranked #1 AI security risk by OWASP in 2025, with no foolproof defense due to the probabilistic nature of LLMs.

concepts/property-graphs.title: Property Graphs
concepts/property-graphs.summary: Node-centric graph data model where nodes and edges carry rich attribute data, optimized for traversal performance and developer experience — the dominant model for production knowledge graph applications.

concepts/quantization.title: Quantization
concepts/quantization.summary: Reducing model weight precision (FP16 → 4-bit) to shrink memory footprint 4x and enable local inference on consumer hardware, with minimal quality loss.

concepts/raft.title: RAFT (Retrieval Augmented Fine-Tuning)
concepts/raft.summary: Hybrid approach training models on questions with oracle + distractor documents, teaching them to leverage retrieval while ignoring noise — up to 76% improvement over baselines.

concepts/rag-evaluation.title: RAG Evaluation
concepts/rag-evaluation.summary: The discipline of measuring RAG system quality across three tiers — retrieval metrics (Precision@k, MRR, nDCG), generation metrics (faithfulness, hallucination rate), and operational metrics (latency, safety) — using frameworks like RAGAS and benchmarks like RAGBench.

concepts/rag-hallucinations.title: RAG Hallucinations
concepts/rag-hallucinations.summary: Fabricated or incorrect outputs from RAG systems despite access to grounding sources — caused by retrieval failures, cross-document fusion errors, and confidence misalignment. Stanford found 17-33% hallucination in legal RAG tools.

concepts/rag-prompting.title: RAG Prompting
concepts/rag-prompting.summary: Prompt engineering techniques specific to RAG pipelines — query rewriting (HyDE, Query2Doc), context integration, and generation prompts — where 'weak retrieval makes things messy, but weak prompts make things unusable.'

concepts/rag-vs-index-based-retrieval.title: RAG vs. Index-Based Retrieval
concepts/rag-vs-index-based-retrieval.summary: At small-to-medium scale (~100 articles, ~400K words), LLM-maintained index files and one-line summaries can replace vector database RAG for document Q&A.

concepts/raptor.title: RAPTOR (Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval)
concepts/raptor.summary: ICLR 2024 technique that recursively clusters and summarizes text chunks into a tree structure, enabling retrieval at multiple abstraction levels — achieving 20% absolute improvement on QuALITY benchmark.

concepts/rdf-knowledge-representation.title: RDF Knowledge Representation
concepts/rdf-knowledge-representation.summary: The W3C-standardized Resource Description Framework for representing knowledge as subject-predicate-object triples with URIs, SPARQL queries, and OWL reasoning — the semantic web foundation for formal knowledge graphs.

concepts/react-pattern.title: ReAct Pattern
concepts/react-pattern.summary: The Thought-Action-Observation loop that enables LLM agents to interleave reasoning with real-world actions, outperforming both pure reasoning (CoT) and action-only approaches.

concepts/reasoning-models.title: Reasoning Models
concepts/reasoning-models.summary: LLMs specifically trained (via RL) to perform extended deliberation before answering -- including OpenAI o1/o3, DeepSeek R1, and Claude 3.7 with extended thinking -- representing the internalization of chain-of-thought reasoning through reinforcement learning.

concepts/red-teaming.title: Red Teaming
concepts/red-teaming.summary: Deliberate adversarial testing of LLM systems to uncover safety vulnerabilities — covering prompt injection, jailbreaking, multi-turn attacks, and automated red teaming frameworks.

concepts/reflection-pattern.title: Reflection Pattern
concepts/reflection-pattern.summary: Automated self-critique pattern where LLMs evaluate and iteratively improve their own outputs, delivering surprising performance gains with relatively simple implementation.

concepts/reinforcement-learning-for-reas.title: Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning
concepts/reinforcement-learning-for-reas.summary: Using RL (GRPO, PPO, scaled RL with verifiers) to train LLMs to develop reasoning capabilities -- the core training methodology behind o1, o3, and R1, enabling emergent self-verification and reasoning without supervised fine-tuning.

concepts/relation-extraction.title: Relation Extraction with LLMs
concepts/relation-extraction.summary: Extracting subject-predicate-object relationships between entities from text — LLMs enable zero-shot relation extraction that matches supervised models, feeding knowledge graph construction.

concepts/reranking.title: Reranking
concepts/reranking.summary: Using cross-encoder models to re-score and reorder retrieval candidates, improving RAG precision by 30-50% by applying query-specific analysis to the top-k results from fast initial retrieval.

concepts/responsible-scaling-policy.title: Responsible Scaling Policy (RSP)
concepts/responsible-scaling-policy.summary: Anthropic's risk governance framework using AI Safety Levels (ASL-1 through ASL-5) modeled after biosafety levels, requiring escalating safeguards proportional to model capabilities -- evolved through 6 versions from September 2023 to April 2026.

concepts/retrieval-augmented-generation.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
concepts/retrieval-augmented-generation.summary: The dominant paradigm for grounding LLM outputs in external knowledge: retrieve relevant documents at query time, inject them as context, and generate answers — now evolving into modular, agentic context engines.

concepts/reward-hacking.title: Reward Hacking and Overoptimization
concepts/reward-hacking.summary: The phenomenon where RL agents exploit flaws in proxy reward functions to achieve high scores without genuine improvement -- Goodhart's Law applied to LLM alignment, manifesting as sycophancy, verbosity gaming, and fabricated evidence.

concepts/reward-model.title: Reward Model
concepts/reward-model.summary: A learned preference function -- typically an LLM with a linear head producing scalar scores -- trained on human preference data to serve as the optimization target in RLHF, bridging human judgments and RL training signals.

concepts/rlaif.title: Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF)
concepts/rlaif.summary: An alignment technique that replaces human preference annotators with LLM-generated labels, achieving statistical parity with RLHF at dramatically lower cost and enabling fully automated preference data pipelines.

concepts/rlhf.title: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF)
concepts/rlhf.summary: The dominant technique for aligning LLMs with human preferences: train a reward model on human preference data, then fine-tune the LLM using PPO to maximize that reward while staying close to the reference policy.

concepts/role-prompting.title: Role Prompting
concepts/role-prompting.summary: Assigning a persona or expert identity to an LLM — effective for tone/style control and creative tasks, but unreliable for factual accuracy where 'none of the strategies outperformed random selection.'

concepts/rotary-position-embeddings.title: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE)
concepts/rotary-position-embeddings.summary: Position encoding via complex-number rotation of embedding pairs — parameter-free, inherently relative, compatible with efficient attention, and the standard for all modern LLMs (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, etc.).

concepts/scalable-oversight.title: Scalable Oversight
concepts/scalable-oversight.summary: The challenge of maintaining meaningful human oversight over AI systems that are more capable than their overseers — addressed through recursive oversight, debate, weak-to-strong generalization, and AI-governing-AI architectures.

concepts/scaling-laws.title: Scaling Laws
concepts/scaling-laws.summary: Mathematical relationships between model size, dataset size, compute budget, and (recently) data quality that predict LLM performance — from the original Kaplan/Chinchilla laws to quality-aware extensions.

concepts/schema-guided-extraction.title: Schema-Guided and Ontology-Driven Extraction
concepts/schema-guided-extraction.summary: Constraining LLM extraction with predefined schemas or ontologies — from static templates to dynamic, co-evolving schemas — trading flexibility for precision and consistency.

concepts/second-brain.title: Second Brain
concepts/second-brain.summary: A personal AI system that stores, organizes, and retrieves the user's own knowledge — implemented either as a markdown wiki (Karpathy), a graph database (Gallagher), or a RAG pipeline (Decoding AI), all using LLMs as the intelligence layer.

concepts/selective-state-space.title: Selective State Space (S6)
concepts/selective-state-space.summary: Mamba's core innovation: making SSM state transition matrices B, C and step size delta input-dependent, enabling content-aware selective information compression into the hidden state.

concepts/self-attention.title: Self-Attention
concepts/self-attention.summary: The mechanism allowing each position in a sequence to attend to all others by computing scaled dot products between learned Query, Key, and Value projections — the core innovation of the Transformer.

concepts/self-consistency-prompting.title: Self-Consistency Prompting
concepts/self-consistency-prompting.summary: Wang et al. (2022) technique that improves CoT by sampling multiple diverse reasoning paths and selecting the most frequent answer via majority voting — more reliable than single-path CoT.

concepts/self-consistency.title: Self-Consistency
concepts/self-consistency.summary: A reasoning enhancement technique that samples multiple chain-of-thought solutions to the same problem and selects the most frequent answer via majority voting, improving accuracy on arithmetic and commonsense reasoning benchmarks.

concepts/self-rag.title: Self-RAG (Self-Reflective Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
concepts/self-rag.summary: An advanced RAG framework that trains four reflection tokens into the model — Retrieve, ISREL, ISSUP, ISUSE — enabling self-assessment of when to retrieve, what's relevant, and whether outputs are evidence-supported.

concepts/self-supervised-learning.title: Self-Supervised Learning
concepts/self-supervised-learning.summary: Learning representations from unlabeled data via pretext tasks — from contrastive learning (SimCLR, CLIP) to joint embedding prediction (JEPA) — the foundational training paradigm for world models that learn from millions of hours of internet video.

concepts/semantic-caching.title: Semantic Caching
concepts/semantic-caching.summary: Caching LLM responses keyed by semantic similarity rather than exact string match, using vector embeddings to identify similar queries and return pre-computed answers in milliseconds — achieving 61-73% cost reduction.

concepts/semantic-layer.title: Semantic Layer
concepts/semantic-layer.summary: A standardized framework that organizes and abstracts organizational data (structured, unstructured, semi-structured) to serve as a connector between data repositories and front-end applications. Comprises business glossaries, controlled metadata, data catalogs, taxonomies, and ontologies/knowledge graphs. Identified as the key enabling technology for enterprise AI in 2026.

concepts/semantic-search.title: Semantic Search
concepts/semantic-search.summary: Search based on meaning rather than exact terms: transformer models encode text into dense vectors, enabling retrieval of conceptually related content even when queries and documents share no common words.

concepts/semantic-web.title: Semantic Web
concepts/semantic-web.summary: Tim Berners-Lee's vision (1994-present) for a machine-readable web of structured data using RDF/OWL/SPARQL — partially realized in enterprise settings and projects like Wikidata, but never achieving mass adoption due to formalization costs.

concepts/sentencepiece.title: SentencePiece
concepts/sentencepiece.summary: A language-agnostic tokenization library that applies BPE or Unigram directly on raw text streams — critical for languages like Chinese and Japanese that lack whitespace word boundaries.

concepts/sliding-window-attention.title: Sliding Window Attention
concepts/sliding-window-attention.summary: Sparse attention restricting each token to attend only to the W most recent tokens, bounding KV cache size while leveraging layer stacking for an effective receptive field of W * n_layers.

concepts/small-language-models.title: Small Language Models (SLMs)
concepts/small-language-models.summary: Models under 10B parameters (Phi-4, Gemma 3, Qwen 3 4B) that run on 4GB RAM with quantization, achieving 10-30x cost reduction vs. LLMs while handling many practical tasks.

concepts/software-2-0.title: Software 2.0
concepts/software-2-0.summary: Karpathy's 2017 paradigm: neural networks as a new programming model where datasets replace source code, training replaces compilation, and data curation replaces instruction-writing -- the intellectual foundation for vibe coding and the code-to-knowledge shift.

concepts/spaced-repetition.title: Spaced Repetition
concepts/spaced-repetition.summary: A learning technique that combats the forgetting curve through adaptively scheduled review — essential complement to PKM systems that build connections (Zettelkasten, evergreen notes) by ensuring knowledge is actually retainable and recallable.

concepts/sparse-attention.title: Sparse Attention
concepts/sparse-attention.summary: Attention mechanisms computing only a subset of the full N x N token interactions — via fixed patterns (Longformer), block routing, clustering, or periodic strides — reducing quadratic complexity toward linear.

concepts/spec-driven-development.title: Spec-Driven Development
concepts/spec-driven-development.summary: The practice of writing detailed specification documents (spec.md, requirements.md) before AI code generation — described as 'waterfall in 15 minutes' — eliminating 80% of AI confusion and serving as contracts between humans and agents.

concepts/speculative-decoding.title: Speculative Decoding
concepts/speculative-decoding.summary: A latency optimization pairing a small draft model with a large target model: the draft proposes tokens, the target verifies in parallel, achieving 2-3x speedup with mathematically guaranteed output equivalence.

concepts/splade.title: SPLADE (Sparse Lexical and Expansion Model)
concepts/splade.summary: A learned sparse retrieval model using transformer encoding to generate sparse vectors with vocabulary expansion — outperforms BM25 on BEIR benchmarks while maintaining inverted index compatibility.

concepts/state-space-models.title: State Space Models (SSMs)
concepts/state-space-models.summary: Sequence models based on continuous-time state equations, offering linear-time inference and fixed memory — the primary architectural alternative to transformers, especially for long sequences and raw data.

concepts/static-site-generators.title: Static Site Generators
concepts/static-site-generators.summary: Hugo, Jekyll, Astro, Eleventy, Gatsby, and Next.js all consume markdown as their primary content format — making markdown the default authoring language for the modern web.

concepts/stochastic-parrot-debate.title: The Stochastic Parrot Debate
concepts/stochastic-parrot-debate.summary: The ongoing debate about whether LLMs genuinely reason and understand or merely perform sophisticated statistical pattern matching -- with evidence on both sides from reasoning benchmarks, adversarial tests, mechanistic interpretability, and philosophical analysis.

concepts/structured-data-extraction.title: Structured Data Extraction (Schema.org)
concepts/structured-data-extraction.summary: Extracting pre-structured data (JSON-LD, Microdata, RDFa) from web pages using Schema.org vocabularies — 45M+ domains provide machine-readable entities and metadata that bypass heuristic extraction entirely.

concepts/structured-output-extraction.title: Structured Output Extraction
concepts/structured-output-extraction.summary: Forcing LLM outputs into schema-conformant JSON/objects via constrained decoding (FSM) or validation-retry loops — the production backbone of all extraction pipelines.

concepts/structured-output-prompting.title: Structured Output Prompting
concepts/structured-output-prompting.summary: Techniques for getting LLMs to produce predictable, parseable output formats (JSON, XML, Markdown tables) — essential for production systems that programmatically consume model outputs.

concepts/subword-tokenization.title: Subword Tokenization
concepts/subword-tokenization.summary: The dominant tokenization paradigm for modern LLMs — splitting text into units between words and characters, keeping frequent words intact while decomposing rare words into meaningful subword pieces.

concepts/swe-bench.title: SWE-bench
concepts/swe-bench.summary: Primary benchmark for evaluating LLM software engineering agents on real-world GitHub issues, progressing from 1.96% (2024) to 80.9% (Claude Opus 4.5, 2026) on Verified subset.

concepts/sycophancy.title: Sycophancy
concepts/sycophancy.summary: An RLHF failure mode where models learn to match user beliefs and flatter rather than inform, because belief-matching is the strongest predictor of human approval in preference data.

concepts/symbolic-ai.title: Symbolic AI
concepts/symbolic-ai.summary: The paradigm (1950s-present) that intelligence arises from manipulating human-readable symbols via logic and rules — dominant through the 1980s, eclipsed by deep learning, now resurging via neural-symbolic hybrid approaches.

concepts/symbolic-vs-connectionist.title: Symbolic vs. Connectionist Debate
concepts/symbolic-vs-connectionist.summary: AI's central paradigm war: whether intelligence arises from symbol manipulation (logic, rules) or distributed numerical computation (neural networks) — now largely resolved toward complementarity via the System 1/System 2 analogy.

concepts/synthetic-data-generation.title: Synthetic Data Generation
concepts/synthetic-data-generation.summary: Using LLMs to generate training data at scale — from textbook-quality corpora to instruction-following datasets — with quality filtering as the critical success factor.

concepts/synthetic-data-in-pretraining.title: Synthetic Data in Pretraining
concepts/synthetic-data-in-pretraining.summary: Using LLM-generated data to augment natural web text in pretraining — optimal at ~30% rephrased synthetic mixed with ~70% natural data, but pure synthetic or textbook-style data shows model collapse risks.

concepts/system-1-system-2-thinking.title: System 1 / System 2 Thinking in LLMs
concepts/system-1-system-2-thinking.summary: Applying Kahneman's dual-process theory to LLMs: standard models as System 1 (fast, intuitive, cheap) vs. reasoning models as System 2 (slow, deliberate, expensive) -- with hybrid toggle approaches emerging as the practical optimum.

concepts/system-prompt-design.title: System Prompt Design
concepts/system-prompt-design.summary: Architectural patterns for system prompts that define consistent LLM behavior, roles, and constraints — the foundation layer that shapes all subsequent interactions.

concepts/tacit-knowledge-capture.title: Tacit Knowledge Capture
concepts/tacit-knowledge-capture.summary: The capture of experiential, undocumented knowledge that exists only in employees' heads. Historically the hardest KM challenge. AI note-taking, automated transcription, and meeting platforms now make enterprise-scale tacit knowledge programs feasible for the first time. Critical because tacit knowledge walks out the door with employee turnover.

concepts/temporal-knowledge-graphs.title: Temporal Knowledge Graphs
concepts/temporal-knowledge-graphs.summary: Knowledge graphs that associate facts with explicit temporal information (timestamps or intervals), enabling reasoning about what was true when — with 10+ method categories from translation-based to LLM-integrated approaches.

concepts/temporal-knowledge.title: Temporal Knowledge
concepts/temporal-knowledge.summary: Graphiti's core contribution: representing knowledge with temporal validity windows (when a fact became true and when it was superseded) rather than treating facts as eternally true or false — critical for AI agents in dynamic environments.

concepts/tensor-parallelism.title: Tensor Parallelism
concepts/tensor-parallelism.summary: Intra-layer parallelism that splits individual weight matrices across GPUs — communication-intensive but essential for models that exceed single-GPU memory. Best within nodes using high-bandwidth NVLink interconnects.

concepts/test-time-compute.title: Test-Time Compute Scaling
concepts/test-time-compute.summary: The paradigm of allocating additional computation at inference time (rather than training time) to improve reasoning -- enabling small models to outperform 14x larger models and forming the computational foundation of reasoning models like o1, o3, and R1.

concepts/text-embeddings.title: Text Embeddings
concepts/text-embeddings.summary: Dense vector representations of text that capture semantic meaning, enabling similarity-based retrieval; the foundation of modern semantic search, RAG, and vector database infrastructure.

concepts/token-counting.title: Token Counting
concepts/token-counting.summary: Practical techniques for counting and estimating token usage in LLM applications — critical for cost management, context window budgeting, and prompt engineering.

concepts/token-optimization.title: Token Optimization
concepts/token-optimization.summary: Systematic reduction of token consumption through prompt compression, output constraints, conversation history management, and context assembly optimization — cutting 20-40% of token waste without infrastructure changes.

concepts/tokenization.title: Tokenization
concepts/tokenization.summary: The process of converting raw text into discrete integer tokens that LLMs can process — the fundamental first step in all language model pipelines.

concepts/tool-use-standards.title: Tool Use Standards for LLMs
concepts/tool-use-standards.summary: The evolving landscape of standards for connecting LLMs to external tools: from vendor-specific function calling (2023) through universal MCP (2024-2025) to the six-protocol agent stack (2026) covering tools, agents, commerce, payments, UI, and streaming.

concepts/tool-use.title: Tool Use (Function Calling)
concepts/tool-use.summary: The mechanism by which LLM agents interact with external systems: generating structured function calls that a runtime executes, standardized via MCP.

concepts/training-data-curation.title: Training Data Curation
concepts/training-data-curation.summary: The process of transforming raw web crawls into high-quality LLM training datasets through text extraction, heuristic filtering, model-based quality scoring, deduplication, and data mixing — the single highest-leverage activity in LLM development.

concepts/training-infrastructure.title: Training Infrastructure
concepts/training-infrastructure.summary: The GPU clusters, networking, and storage systems required for LLM pretraining: NVIDIA H100/H200/B200 GPUs, NVLink intra-node (900 GB/s), InfiniBand inter-node, with frontier runs using 5,000-16,000+ GPUs.

concepts/training-stability.title: Training Stability
concepts/training-stability.summary: Keeping LLM training runs from diverging over weeks/months: preventing loss spikes via gradient clipping, proper initialization, BFloat16 precision, learning rate warmup, and specialized optimizers (SPAM, LAMB).

concepts/training-vs-inference-compute.title: Training-Time vs. Inference-Time Compute
concepts/training-vs-inference-compute.summary: The fundamental paradigm shift in AI from 'train bigger models' to 'reason harder at inference' -- with inference demand projected to exceed training by 118x by 2026 and reshaping the entire AI infrastructure landscape.

concepts/transactive-memory-systems.title: Transactive Memory Systems
concepts/transactive-memory-systems.summary: The distributed cognitive architecture of groups: who knows what, how to access distributed expertise, and how attention and reasoning are coordinated — now being augmented and threatened by AI in the COHUMAIN framework.

concepts/transclusion.title: Transclusion
concepts/transclusion.summary: Ted Nelson's concept of including content from one document inside another by reference rather than by copy — never widely adopted but anticipating modern content embedding, syndication, and wiki transclusion.

concepts/transformer-architecture.title: Transformer Architecture
concepts/transformer-architecture.summary: The foundational neural network architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms, introduced in 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017), now powering virtually all frontier LLMs, vision models, and multimodal systems.

concepts/tree-of-thought.title: Tree of Thoughts
concepts/tree-of-thought.summary: A reasoning framework (NeurIPS 2023) that generalizes chain-of-thought by exploring multiple reasoning paths via tree search (BFS/DFS), enabling backtracking and self-evaluation -- achieving 74% on Game of 24 vs. CoT's 4%.

concepts/tree-of-thoughts-prompting.title: Tree of Thoughts Prompting
concepts/tree-of-thoughts-prompting.summary: Yao et al. (2023) framework that generalizes CoT into a tree-structured exploration of reasoning paths with search algorithms (BFS/DFS), enabling deliberate problem-solving with lookahead and backtracking.

concepts/trust-calibration.title: Trust Calibration
concepts/trust-calibration.summary: The research field studying how to match user reliance on AI with actual AI reliability — the engagement-overload paradox means more explanation can backfire, requiring careful interface calibration.

concepts/trust-in-ai.title: Trust in AI
concepts/trust-in-ai.summary: Trust is the true currency of AI products — built through transparency, appropriate friction, citations, confidence signals, and consistent competence over time; both over-trust (automation bias) and under-trust are failure modes.

concepts/two-stage-retrieval.title: Two-Stage Retrieval
concepts/two-stage-retrieval.summary: The standard RAG retrieval architecture: fast bi-encoder/hybrid retrieval narrows millions of documents to top-k candidates, then a cross-encoder reranker selects the top-n most relevant for the LLM.

concepts/unigram-tokenization.title: Unigram Tokenization
concepts/unigram-tokenization.summary: Top-down probabilistic tokenization algorithm that starts with a large candidate vocabulary and iteratively prunes the least impactful tokens — used by T5, BigBird, and Pegasus.

concepts/us-china-ai-race.title: US-China AI Race
concepts/us-china-ai-race.summary: The defining geopolitical competition of the AI era — US leads in model quality (7-month average gap), market share (93%), compute (5-17x chip advantage), and capital ($250B Q1 2026); China closing via algorithmic efficiency, open source strategy, and state-backed ecosystem.

concepts/vault-organization.title: Vault Organization Strategies
concepts/vault-organization.summary: Strategies for organizing Obsidian vaults: flat folders + profuse links (Ango), PARA method, type-based folders, and AI-optimized architectures with context engineering.

concepts/vault-separation.title: Vault Separation
concepts/vault-separation.summary: Steph Ango's (Obsidian CEO) recommendation to maintain a clean human-curated Obsidian vault separately from agent-generated content, preventing hallucination contamination of personal knowledge.

concepts/vector-databases.title: Vector Databases
concepts/vector-databases.summary: Specialized databases for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) search over embedding vectors, necessary at billion-vector scale but often overkill for personal or team-scale LLM knowledge bases where pgvector, FAISS, or index-based LLM navigation suffice.

concepts/vector-search.title: Vector Search
concepts/vector-search.summary: Finding similar items by computing distance between dense vector embeddings in high-dimensional space, typically using ANN algorithms like HNSW for sub-millisecond retrieval at scale.

concepts/vibe-coding.title: Vibe Coding
concepts/vibe-coding.summary: Karpathy's February 2025 term for natural-language-driven development with minimal code review -- Collins Word of the Year 2025 -- which followed a clear arc from excitement to 'hangover' to Karpathy himself declaring it passe in favor of agentic engineering.

concepts/video-generation-as-world-simul.title: Video Generation as World Simulation
concepts/video-generation-as-world-simul.summary: The hypothesis that scaling video generation trains implicit world simulators — pioneered by OpenAI's Sora, validated by emergent 3D consistency and physics at scale, but challenged by fundamental gaps between statistical video prediction and true causal world modeling.

concepts/virtual-context-management.title: Virtual Context Management
concepts/virtual-context-management.summary: OS-inspired technique where LLMs page information between in-context memory (RAM) and external storage (disk), creating the illusion of unlimited context within fixed windows.

concepts/vision-language-action-models.title: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Models
concepts/vision-language-action-models.summary: Neural architectures that unify visual perception, language understanding, and motor control in a single model — the core enabling technology for embodied AI, evolving from RT-2 (2023) through π0 and GR00T-N1 to general-purpose robot control.

concepts/vision-language-models.title: Vision-Language Models
concepts/vision-language-models.summary: Models that jointly process images and text — from CLIP's dual encoders to GPT-4V/Claude/Qwen3-VL's vision-integrated LLMs; by 2026, open-source VLMs rival proprietary frontier models.

concepts/visual-question-answering.title: Visual Question Answering
concepts/visual-question-answering.summary: AI task of answering natural language questions about images — considered 'AI-complete'; evolved from CNN+LSTM+attention to VLM-based approaches achieving 82%+ on key benchmarks.

concepts/vocabulary-size-tradeoffs.title: Vocabulary Size Tradeoffs
concepts/vocabulary-size-tradeoffs.summary: The fundamental tension between vocabulary size, sequence length, embedding overhead, and language coverage — with modern LLMs trending from 32k toward 100k-131k tokens.

concepts/web-archiving.title: Web Archiving
concepts/web-archiving.summary: Preserving web content in standardized WARC (ISO 28500) format for permanence and provenance — from institutional tools (Heritrix, Wayback Machine) to personal archiving (ArchiveBox, SingleFile) — critical for knowledge base source integrity.

concepts/web-scraping-at-scale.title: Web Scraping at Scale
concepts/web-scraping-at-scale.summary: Modern web scraping for AI pipelines: async concurrency, proxy rotation, headless browsers for JS, API-based services (Firecrawl, Crawl4AI) that output LLM-ready markdown, and scaling from scripts to microservice architectures.

concepts/web-scraping-ethics-and-law.title: Web Scraping Ethics and Law
concepts/web-scraping-ethics-and-law.summary: Legal framework for web scraping: public data is generally legal (hiQ v. LinkedIn); GDPR imposes EUR 20M fines for personal data; EU AI Act requires training data provenance; robots.txt compliance is legally relevant though not binding.

concepts/weights-vs-context.title: Weights vs. Context Window: Where to Put Knowledge
concepts/weights-vs-context.summary: The fundamental design question for LLM applications: which knowledge belongs in model weights (persistent, fast, opaque) vs. context windows (dynamic, traceable, limited) vs. external tools.
